༄༅// chos sde'i gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i gleng ba kun dga'i 'dzum zer 'dzag pa'i zla gzhon zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta yi ge nyi shu pa byed ldan la spyir gyi grangs sa ya gcig dang bzhi khri brgyad stong lnga brgya don drug mchis par yang ba'i bya ba gcig yang ba nyi shu rjes 'brangs bcas/ yi ge bye ba gnyis rjes 'brangs bcas/ ci yang bye ba gcig rjes 'brangs bcas/ phyi mo bye ba gsum rjes 'brangs bcas/ a dh+wa 'phred sa ya gnyis/ rjes 'brangs bcas yod pa'i nang gsel gzhung gis ma zin pa ud+dh-iṣ+ṭa bzhi 'bum bzhi khri lnga stong drug brgya re dgu pa'i prāsta rās mdzes par byas pa'o// ༄༅// yaḥkalpanirmeyasamayebh+yomanikānāmabhikāmarathaukar+m+mainirābhogaparipūraṣ+yaguṇāyabyayalab+dhitawā/ ༄༅// gang rgya che ba'i rgyan las bsam pa rgya che bas mdzes pa'i shis brjod/ zhig bskal pa dpag med dus nas yid can mngon 'dod shing rta dag /lhun grub mdzad pas phyur bur 'gengs pa'i yon tan 'dzad med brnyes gyur kyang*// ༄༅// dz+nyānapradīpot+tamayugātraswasubikrān+t+yanirud+dhamayānan+taprayats+tshan+tugatidhātus+samasūk+taṃshubhasaṅguruṇā// ༄༅// dus 'dir ye shes snang ba mchog gi rang rtsal ma 'gags sgyu 'phrul gyis// mu med 'gro khams 'tsham par legs 'doms bla ma dam pas dge legs stsol// phyag bya ba'i sgo dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi rab brtag yid 'ong shis pa'i mtshan ris kyis bkra sa gsum snying por gyur pa'i khur// brtan ldan rang gi phrag par 'god la theg dka'i 'phyang mo nyug la brten// 'od srungs byin de rnam drug 'dar ba'i lus phyed steng du phyung ba snyam// skye dgu yongs kyi thor tshugs rtse mos lan brgyar btud pa shāṃkyaṃ'i togaṃ /'char gnyis pa bya ba ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/

ka'i mi sbyin skyes kyi lang tsho dar bab min pa yang ma byas// gur gum nags klung rgyas pa'i tshos las byed po su zhig phyung ba med// ngo mtshar lta byed dbang po'i brtan 'phrog sin+dhū wā ra'i mdangs 'od gsal// bgrang gzhi bcu drug son pa'i nyams ldan 'jaṃm dpaṃl gzhon nuṃ bdag blor spyon// dri bzang gsum pa mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgras zin pa'i dpe rgyan/ khang pa'i 'dab mar co 'dri'i 'jaṃm mnyen phyag gi yal 'dab rtser// gser mngal gsung gi khengs pa 'gog byed rgyud mangs dbyangs dang lhan cig nyid// gtsug lag rab 'byams snyan dngags glur 'bab skal ldan shing rtar dgod pa can// ngag gi dpaṃl 'jo dbyaṃngs kyiṃ rgyalaṃ moṃ rang nyid 'dra bar bdag byin rlobs// mtha' bzhi pa 'os pa'i cha rgyan gyis spud pa/ klas gsung rab yongs kyi bzhed pa mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i lam nyid nas// 'chad pa'i yon tan rgyal ba'i ye shes zab mo nyid dang mnyam song ba'i// rnam par thar pas blo ldan lus skyes cig car bskyod de kha ba'i ljongs// rab bsil ser bus gzing ba min nam saṃ skya'iṃ rjeṃ btsuṃn rnaṃm paṃ lngaṃ/ /lnga pa sems ldan rab brtag shes bya kunaṃ mkhyen dgaṃ' ba'i dpal bskyed gang zhig chos dang sems can khams// sman 'dogs sgrub pa'i yon tan bzaṃng poṃ mngon gyur 'phrin yig phyogs kyi gzhir// rdzogs par bris pa'i ya mtshan chos kyi mig yangs rjes su slob pa dag /gser ldan lus phra'i dkyil 'khor mu med khyab par nyul shing blta ba snyam// thams drug pa ngo mtshar phul byung*/ cad mkhyen pa de sras dang bcas zhing khaṃms chu gter rdul snyed dag /nyes med tshulaṃ khriṃms dag pa'i zlos gar ba spu skye ba'i go re la// chud par dka' bas dben pa'i 'phrul 'dis sangs rgyas yon tan bkod pa'i gtam// nyung ngur bgyid pa'i thub chod 'di ci phrin las lhunaṃ gyis gruṃb pa khyod// riṃn

bdun pa rigs brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed/ cheṃn gsum dngos chos kyi rgyaṃl mtshaṃn 'chang*// de sogs 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i skye ba'i gar// ljongs kyi thig le 'diṃr bsgyuraṃ bdeṃ gsheṃgs kyi// bstanaṃ paṃ'i snangaṃ byedaṃ gaṃng daṃg byonaṃ rnams dang*// mkhyen brgyad pa bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ nus brtse ba grub pas choṃs kyi sdeṃr// thar 'dod kunaṃ dgaṃ' bskyed pa'i gan+dho la// bslab gsum 'chang gi 'phaṃgs paṃ'i thun mtshams sprin// sdud byed dam pa'i rnam thar bsams kyin dad// dgu pa skyed byed kyi rgyud/ thamaṃs cadaṃ mkhyeṃn lam sbyangs paṃ mthar phyin pas// dpalaṃ ldaṃn thub pa'i choṃs tshul dri ma med// rgyal sras spyod pas skyoṃng ba'i phrin las mu// mkha' dang mnyam nyid song la nyer btud nas// sdeṃ bzhi'i 'di nas brtsams te dngos po nges par bstan pa yan lag gnyis pa'i gzugs can/ dpal 'byor gyi mtho rgyal thabs su// dgeṃ bcu'i bka' lung 'khor lo sngon 'gro bar// dpag yas bsod nams gnam gyi mthongs yangs nas// bkra shis cho gas dbang bskur blaṃ maṃ che// yan lag gnyis pa'i gzugs can/ gang de'i byang chub spyod pa'i chu gter che// dge ba'i nyal 'gros kun nas dgang phyir du// 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma dal 'bab 'gram// bshad sgrub sgra dbyangs snyan pa choṃs kyi sdeṃr// mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgras zin pa'i dpe rgyan/ stobs bcu mnga' bstan ring 'tsho'i rtsa lag tu// dge slong dge 'dun 'du ba'i gaṃn+dho laṃ// gzugs khams 'og min sa la 'phos 'dra can// gsar bskrun rten dang brten pa'i ngo mtshar gtam// rab brtag las min nam sgra can/ yid 'phrog dbyangs kyi rgyal mo snyan dngags glu// ci 'dod dbyangs su len phyir tam+bu raḥ// snyan dgu 'khrol ba'i zol gyis bdag cag gi /longs spyod 'khor lor dgyes dgur rtsen min nam// dbyar

bya ba brjod pa tha ma'i gsal byed/ rnga dal gyis dgod la mdongs mtha' can// legs bshad 'chad la rnam par dpyod ldan tshogs// lo rgyus bsnyad 'dir bsod nams tshogs rjes su// yi rang bsgom pa'i sgra 'dzin cis mi gtod// phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu/ brjod bya srid pas rnam sprul sdig pa med// brjod tshul kha gsags gzhan 'drid cho ga min// de phyir bde gshegs rten gsum bskrun pa las// brtsams pa'i 'bel gtam gleng la bdag dga' 'o// de'ang rang re legs bris bcas pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mchog bla na ma mchis pa nyi ma'i rgyud kyi skye ba mchog gi sdong bur blangs pa thams cad mkhyen pa shākya seng ges legs par gsungs pa'i snang ba dam pa'i rjes su zhugs shing rjes su slob par 'dod pa'i yid can/ bgo skal mi dman par gyur pa dag gis/ srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun las skyob par nges pa'i dkon cog gsum skyabs su bsten cing*/ de'i bslab byar gser mngal can dang dpal gyi mgrin pa sogs 'jig rten 'dir grags shing che bar rlom pa rnams rnam pa thams cad du rten dang gling du bzung ba dang*/ de dag gis rjes su bstan pa rnams lhur len pa ring du spangs nas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' lung rjes su bsgrub pa dang*/ de dag gi bsti gnas gtsug lag khang brtsig pa dang*/ rten gsum phreng ba bskrun pa dang*/ mchod sprin gyi khyad par mang po dag gis mdun bdar te mchod cing bsti stang bgyid pa la brtson pa ni/ dal 'byor gyi rten las snying po mchog blangs par 'gyur nges pa'o snyam du dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pas nye bar bslangs pa'i dpal sde dge sa skyong sdom brtson bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po sku mched du bcas pa dag gis dngos po sbyor bkod phun sum tshogs pa stsal te ljongs kyi thig le 'dir/ ngur smrig 'chang gi dge 'dun 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang pho brang dang 'brel ba'i rten dang brten pa ji ltar bskrun pa las brtsams pa'i gleng ba nyung 'dus yi ge'i lam nas 'chad pa la/

gang du bskrun pa'i gnas/ der ji ltar bskrun pa'i tshul/ bskrun pa'i rten gyi bzhugs byang smos pa/ las mthar phyin pa'i bya ba/ mjug phan yon yongs su bsngo ba'o// dang po la sa'i cha ngos gzung ba dang*/ der sa bdag ji ltar byung ba'o// dang po ni/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang khyad par bcom ldan 'das bu ram shing pa nyid kyis gdod ma'i bskal pa bgrang las 'das pa'i dus nas byang chub mchog gi thugs bskyed g.yar dam gyi yi ge dam pa yid srubs bye ba'i dpung pas gsub tu med pa thugs kar bkod pa dus su bab par mkhyen nas/ dzam+bu rkang 'thung gi rgyal mtshan gyis nye bar spud pa'i gling bzhi yongs kyi rgyal por gyur pa/ gang gi lto ba byang chub ljon pa'i dbang pos mtshan pa'i drung ga la bar/ mi phyed rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bcas pa gcig cig la/ chu srin rgyal mtshan can sde dang bcas pa'i dpung tshogs bye ba phrag khrig rmeg med du bcom ste/ 'jig rten gsum na sgrun du ma mchis pa/ srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang mngon du bgyis nas/ mi 'jigs bzhi ldan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i rgyud kyi nga ros 'og min gyi bar du ldir bar sgrogs pa la bdud rtsi'i zas can nam/ bcud dang bral ba'am/ yid srubs sam/ mi'am/ gdengs can nam/ dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'i ris su gtogs pa la sogs pa gang su yang rung ba dag klan ka dang bral bar ma zad/ skye dgu kun gyi yan lag mchog gi rtse mor/ gang gi zhabs rdul gtsang ma'i 'bab stegs lan rer bgyis pas kyang*/ mi ring bar rang gi go 'phang dam pa stsol ba'i byed po nyag gcig tu mngon par bsngags pas mnga' gsol bar byas pa'i gnas ni saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du ma hā badz+rā sa na ste/ ljongs 'dir rdo rje'i gdan chen por grags pa'i dbus gyur 'chang ste/ de nyid nas gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'i phyogs su dpag tshad brgya phrag bcal bar/

ji skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i mdo'i yul yongs su spyod par/ yul dbus nas lho phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro// lho phyogs nas byang phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro// byang phyogs nas byang phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro zhes dang*/ lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa'i mdor/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na/ gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa'i yul gru dam pa/ kai la sha'i rwa bas kun nas bskor ba'i bod yul dbus kyi lto ba gang du 'og min 'phags pa'i bsti gnas dang mtshungs pa dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen po zhes yongs su grags pa'i zla 'od dkar pos phyogs kyi lus phra'i bzhin ras rgyas par 'gengs pa'i phan bde'i rtsa lag dam pa nyid du brtan par bzhugs so// de nyid nas kyang dbang dang ldan pa'i phyogs char zhag gi bang mdzod gsum tsam brgal ba ga la ba der ma hā bho ṭa ste bod yul chen por grags pa'i nor 'dzin gyi cha/ 'brog gnas mched lnga'i nang gses kyi lha chen jo bo sgyogs chen gdong ras mtshon/ gzhi bdag mthu bo che dkar po'i phyogs su mngon par dga' ba'i ru mtshon dkar po srid pa'i rtser snyegs par bsgreng ba snyam byed pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs rnams kyis yongs su bsrungs pa'i sa'i thig le/ sngon dus 'phags pa'i yul gyi mkhas grub dbang po shrī smṛ ti dz+nyā na'i zhabs kyi pad+mas ljongs kyi khor yug kun du legs par bcags shing chos kyi ma mo la sogs pa legs par bshad pas byin gyis brlabs mthar/ mdzad pa tha ma'i sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa'i mchod sdong chen po gang de'i dbang po'i phyogs kyi cha/ bod yul gyi gtsug lag khang brtsigs so cog gi thog ma'i ya gyal ldan yul glang thang du grags pa/ 'phang skyob lha mos byang chub kyi spyod pa spyad pas sems can rgya mtsho'i rgyud du legs byas kyi sa bon stobs su bskyod pa'i lha gnas dam pa gang yin pa de'i chu bdag gi phyogs kyi cha/

'od gsal legs bris rigs kyi skye ba dam pa'i myu gu yongs su bzung ba'i rnam par 'dren pa chen po/ lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu'i skyabs mchog dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kunaṃ dgaṃ' bloṃ grosaṃ leṃgs paṃ'i 'byungaṃ gnaṃs rgyalaṃ mtshaṃn dpaṃl bzaṃng poṃ'i gzugs sku chos dbyings su brtul ba'i ring bsrel gyi phung pos mngon par gtams pa'i mchod sdong chen pos brtan par bzhugs pa'i nor sbyin gyi phyogs kyi cha ga la ba/ khams gsum gyi skye 'gro ma lus pa chos srid gser sbyangs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs ma stong phrag rdzogs pas mnga' bsgyur ba la bsnyengs pa dang bral ba'i dpal sa skya pa chen po 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pas mtshon/ slad rol du 'chad par 'gyur ba'i skyes bu chen po rnams kyi zhabs zung bkra shis rtags kyis mngon par spud pa dag gis nye bar bcags pa'i sa gzhi gang la/ btags ming du sga ldan gnyis su grags pa las ldan yul te/ gang las skye 'gro yongs kyi nyer 'tsho dam par gyur pa'i rin po che su wa r+ṇa'i dga' ston 'dzad pa med par 'jo ba'i gter chen po'i dpal dang ldan pas sam/ 'bri klung gser dang ldan ma'i rgyun chen po rgyun phyogs su gzhol zhing 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs yin pas na ldan ma zhes bod pa/ nor ldan lha mo brtan ma'i dkyil 'khor gang gi kho ra khor yug dag tu 'jig rten byed pos ched du bskrun pa lta bu'i ri bo'i phreng ba rnams kyang kha cig ni dpal gyi 'byung gnas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i dbyibs can mthong na mi mthun pa med pa'i lang tsho'i dpal ngom pa lta bu'o// 'ga' zhig ni rkang 'thung dang tshang tshing gi phreng bas mngon par dkrigs pa'i dbyar skyes sgra'i lan bu kun du g.yo ba dang*/ bcas pa la me tog rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bzhad pa'i rgyan phreng ba klubs pa'i nags tshal gyi mtshar sdug de dag ni rang rang gi 'jo sgeg ngom pas 'khod pa can dang*/

la la ni rin po che dang 'bru rigs dang sman dang 'bras bu la sogs pa ci 'dod gtong ba chen pos/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba thams cad rang dbang du sdud pa snyam bgyid pa'i blon po rin po che rnams ni dge legs gsar du bsgrub pa'i 'dun 'gros shom pa la 'khod pa lta bu'o// phal cher kun yid dga' bar byed pa'i dbyar skyes lo 'dab gsar pa'i sdong bu'i dga' ston gzhar yang 'dzad pa med pa'i khur chen gyen du 'degs pa la ngal snyam mi bgyid pa'i sa srungs kyi dbang po sna lag rab tu mdzes pa lta bu'o// phyogs 'ga' zhig tu nor bu chu shel dang*/ an+dha rnyil dang*/ ma ra ka ti dang*/ le brgan rnams kyi lang tsho'i snyems pa la co 'drir bzod pa'i brag ri brtsegs pa mtho zhing skyi g.ya' ba dag 'bigs byed kyi tsher ma rnon po kun nas gzing ba'i tshang tshing 'khrigs pa dag ni dpa' zhing rtul phod pa dang ldan pas pha rol rnam par gnon pa la bsnyengs pa bral ba'i dmag dpon rin po che lta bu'o// 'ga' zhig dag nas skal ldan shing rta'i ro bda'i yan lag gi spun zlar 'os pa'i dag byed gtsang ma'i 'bab rgyun chen pos/ rin chen gser gyi phye ma 'grems par byed pa'i 'bri chu dal gyis 'bab pas nye bar mtshon pa'i dag byed gnam sngon zhun ma'i chu rgyun gyi tshogs rnams dba' rlabs lang ling g.yo ba'i sgra dang chabs cig rgyun phyogs su bgrod pa rnams ni/ cang shes myur 'gro'i dbang po rta mchog brgyad khri'i 'khor dang bcas te/ gser ldan dga' ma'i phang par gom stabs mkhas pa'i tshul gyis gya gyur bgrod pa snyam bgyid pa'o// dbang sngon zhun ma las bgyis pa'i gnam sngon gyi 'khor lo rtsibs ma stong phrag gi yan lag dang nying lag phyogs dang phyogs bral du brkyangs par/ nyin mtshan mun pa stug po'i go skabs dbrog pa'i 'od 'bar nor bu bye ba'i phra tshom mdzes pas bla na 'phags shing*/

nor 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor mu med bdag gir bgyid pa'i rnam pa can dag go /gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan dang ldan pa'i gser mig chu la rkyal ba dang*/ lhab lhub brtsegs pa'i sna tshogs dar gyi rgyal mtshan nam mkha' la 'phyar ba dang*/ yid 'ong dpal gyi be'u 'khyil ba thang mar brdal ba'i dpe zlar snyegs pa'i dge mtshan bzang po'i gzugs kyis kun nas mdzes pa/ de dag kyang nam zla dus tshod bzhi'i mtho ris kyi bu mo dag gi 'phrul gyis so sor bskrun pa'i bgo ba tha dad dag re mos su bgos pas/ bag yangs spyod pa rnams kyi blo sna dge ba'i phyogs su bskul ba'i rnam pa can gyis kun nas mdzes pa'i yul ljongs dam pa/ dge bcur spyod pa'i bdag po'i 'bras bu mtha' dag cig car du smin pas sa gzhi phal che ba dag ngos mi snyoms pa med par brdal ba la yul gyi dge bcu ma tshang ba med pa'i gnas/ skye 'gro ris su ma chad pa'i nyer 'tshor gyur pa'i rin po che dang*/ rtsi sman dang*/ sdong bu dang*/ lo 'dab dang*/ me tog dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ 'bru bcud sna tshogs 'dod dgu'i dpal gyi dga' ston gya nom pa 'byung ba'i gnas su gyur pa gang yin pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i nor ldan brtan ma'i dkyil 'khor de dag bdag gir bzung ba'i sa skyong ji ltar byung ba yin snyam na/ spyir khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhes phyi nang gi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mthar son te/ yang dag pa'i lung dang dngos po stobs shugs kyi rigs pas shes bya thams cad la mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i rgyud kyi nga ro bsgrags pas/ phyi rol gyi gzhung lugs smra ba'i khyu mchog 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa rtog ger smra ba'i dbang phyug gi sder chags rnams kyang mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la brtan par bkod de/ thub dbang bstan pa'i sgor bcug pa sogs mkhas pa dang grub pa'i yi ge'i rnga bo che phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor kun du khengs par ldir bar brten/

gnam gyi she mong spungs pa'i stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po go dan gyis spyan 'dren gyi pho nyas slebs par/ sngon dus rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan rje btsun rin po che dang 'phags yul mkhas pa'i rgyan gyur kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrīs lung bstan gyi 'phrin yig dam pa thugs ka'i dpal gyi be'ur bkra ba rjes su dgongs nas/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa gsum pa shing 'brug la gdan sa chen po nas bteg ste rim gyis ling chu rtse'i rgyal khab tu phebs shing*/ rgyal pos bla'i mchod gnas kyi phud du bkur/ nyi ma nub phyogs pa rnams chos rje par shes su bcug de'i dus na be ri'i dpon phyag g.yog tu khrid pa gong ma la ngo bltar bcug pa legs pas/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum dang dbus gtsang pa bcas pas ngo bltas/ hor dmag bod la mi 'gro ba sogs bod khams bde skyid 'byung ba'i sgo dang po bye/ gang gi tshe gser yig pa btang nas sde rtsis btab ste bod kyi mi dpon chos min spyod pa ma gtogs pa rnams sngar yod sa jus kyi bdag por bkod/ ngo blta legs par byas pa dang ma byas pa 'dzol med kyi yi ger btab nas/ slar chos rje sa skya par phul ba sogs bod khams bde skyid kyi nyi ma sngon ma shar bar mdzad do// de dus tsam na dpon chen khro bo rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas sga zhe'u mdo dang seb la sogs par bzhugs nas/ sgyogs dam sha ri gangs dkar nas hor stong tshar sgang yan dang*/ dbas kyi rdo zam nas a chen ljongs tshun gyis yul phal che ba la dbang bsgyur bar grags// de'i spun zla bar pa du tsha sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes pa mgo zir bzhugs/ gcung bdag po dpal ldan rgyal mtshan zhes pa smad rong pa tsha'i sde mgor bsdad/ de'i mi brgyud phyis su'ang rong pa dpon chung sde dud nyung shas la dbang ba zhig yod ces gleng bar thos so// sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rigs sras seng ge rgyal mtshan dang*/

de bzhin du 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mgon po rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba rnams snga ma snga ma'i rigs sras phyi ma phyi ma yin no// gang gi tshe khams gsum chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chen po 'phags pa rin po che nyid/ gnam bskos dbang phyogs gong ma chen po se chen rgyal po'i bla'i mchod gnas su gyur/ bod khams kyi skye 'gro yongs kyi bdag por mnga' gsol te dbang yon du chol kha gsum sogs phul nas bod khams yongs kyi bdag por mnga' gsol/ slar gdan sa chen por gdan bteg ste ldan yul nas phebs lam mdzad pa na gling dbon mgon po rgyal mtshan gyis/ sa skya pa'i zhabs 'degs legs par grub pa'i zham ring par gyur pa'i dbang gis/ sngar yod pa'i mgo zi'i jus rnams rang dbang du stsal/ de dus shig na 'phags pa rin po ches sga ā nan pa la a gro rong nas dge rgyas rdza dkar nag bar dang*/ lho'i lcags rdo sngon mo nas byang a chen ljongs tshun gyi sa jus rnams stsal/ sku rten rin po che zi khyim las grub pa'i thub pa chen po byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba dang*/ gsung rten rin po che kañca nas bris pa'i bka' 'gyur rin po che/ thugs rten rgya nag 'phrul bzos bskrun pa'i rdo rje dril bu dang gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu sogs rten khyad 'phags kyi rigs mang du stsal to// gzhan yang ā nan pa la gling gi dre'u khral/ dge rgyas kyi mdzo khral/ sga pa'i gser khral/ byang pa'i dkar khral/ ldan ma'i nas khral rnams kyi bsdu sgo bcas yod pa byung ngo*// de skabs ldan gyi gnas chen gying ral yod pa 'dir sa skya'i dgon pa zhig yod pa la 'phags pa rin po ches bkra shis yar lung sgang zhes bya ba mtshan du stsal/ de dus na bkra shis gling 'di yang dgon chung zhig yin par grags/ rab bkram gyi gnas 'dir rnal 'byor pa nam mkha' legs pa zhes bya ba grub pa'i yon tan mang po rdzogs pa zhig bzhugs pa 'phags pa rin po che mjal du 'byon par zhugs pa'i lam nas/

'di ltar mjal rten du gser zhig 'bul du yod na ci ma rung ste gser ni ma mchis snyam du byon pa na/ rgya yur bkra shis mgor phebs pa dang gzhi bdag khams gsum dbang phyug ces bya ba klu'i dbang po'i rnam pa can du sprul te 'ongs nas gser rdog po che ba cig phul bar khong thugs shin tu dgyes nas sa 'di'i ming la bkra shis thog ces brjod par bya'o zhes ming bsgyur stsal/ kha dar dang gser de bsnams te mjal rten du bstabs/ der 'phags pa rin po che'i zhal nas rnal 'byor pa rten 'brel shin tu legs so gsungs nas/ chos kyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad pas thugs dgyes par gyur/ thugs dam rten gyi gur mgon gser sku rgya nag gi bzo rgyu khyad par 'phags pa zhig dang*/ bka' yig rin po che ba so'i phyag tham bcas gnang*/ tham ga de phyis su sa skya pa la phul nas da lta 'dam thog par yod ces gleng*/ der mchod gzhis zhig kyang stsal ba'i dgongs pa mchis pa la rnal 'byor pa spros bral min pa gzhan la mi mos pa'i dbang gis ma zhus/ bzhugs pa na'ang sga ā nan pa dang khri g.yas g.yon 'jog pa gnang*/ nam mkha' legs pa'i sku dbon nam mkha' bkra shis dang nam mkha' dge legs gnyis nas bzung ste da lta'i bar du chos lugs sa skya par gyur/ 'bri khung pas stod hor dmag dang mthun bsdebs kyis bya byed mang tsam bsgrubs pa rgyal po'i snyan du dengs pas dgongs par ye ma bab/ de'i shugs kyis shod zhabs na yod pa'i 'bri khung pa'i dgon chung zhig dang*/ rag co'i ka phug dgon pa dang*/ 'bri klung pha rol gyi ras ras dgon pa rnams chos lugs 'bri khung pa yin pa'i rgyus bka' bkyon phab/ 'bam le dgon pa 'bri khung pa yin pa'ang chos lugs sa skya par bsgyur/ de rjes shig nas jus thams cad a gro la byung*/ 'phags pa rin po che slar yang hor yul nas spyan 'dren gyi pho nyas slebs/ gdan bteg nas byon pa'i skabs/

sga ā nan pas nged la sngar gyi jus srid chen po 'di tsam gyi dgos pa ma mchis zhes 'phags pa la yar phul nas khri 'du'i phyogs tsam zhig min pa rang dbang ma byas/ gang gi tshe a gro dpon la gnyen sras dang*/ se 'bal dang*/ sbal kham dge zhes bya ba ste gsum byung ngo*// phyi mas a gro'i rdzong chen

bya 'bo rdzong*/ bcu 'bo rdzong*/ gnyi 'bo rdzong*/ rdzong dkar/ skye tshong rdzong*/ rdzong dmar/ 'dam rong rdzong*/ gshe gro rdzong*/ ra kho rdzong*/ o da'i rdzong ste/ bcur grags pa bslang ba sogs dang chos min gyi khrims las 'ga' zhig brtsams pa'i skyon gyis/ jus srid thams cad 'phags pa rin po ches yar bzhes so// de rjes tsam nas sa skya pa'i gdung sras zhig kyang phyogs 'dir phebs pa bcas gling dang mchod yon du 'brel pa zab pa byung*/ mthar gyis lo grangs kha shas brgal ba'i skabs shig nas stod phyogs thams cad dge rgyas dang*/ smad phyogs be ris bzung ste phyi ma'i dpon yang dge rgyas yin zhes grag go /byang ngos rdza chu'i 'gram rnams yongs shos bu kun dga' dā'i ching gis zin/ de dus na gling gi dbon yang yongs shos bur gyur/ bar skabs shig gling gi jus srid nang chen par shor yang lo gnyis tsam song mtshams su tshur 'byor/ 'di skabs shig nas sde dgon gong 'og gnyis las gong ma 'di dang por sa lugs kyi dgon pa dgon dpon dben thogs stong dpon bla ma rasmi dh+wa dza zhes bya ba zhig gis byas yod pa des gtsang sa skya sogs mjal du phyin pa'i mar lam dbus su rje btsun btsong kha pa mjal du son par/ rje'i zhal nas rmis ltas legs pa zhig byung bas khyed kyi dgon chung de kho bo'i rjes 'jug cig byas na dge bar shar bas de bzhin dgos tshul dang*/ rje rin po che rang gi tshems rdog po gcig gnang ba dad pas khas 'ches/ mar slebs pa dang dge lugs kyi dgon par bsgyur/ gur mgon gyi sku 'bag byin rlabs che bas mtshon rten 'ga' zhig da lta'ang bzhugs pas/ de la brten pa'i gur mgon lha brgyad kyi bskang ba rgyun 'don du yod/ sde dgon 'og ma 'di sngar bkar brgyud pa sogs chos lugs 'dres ma zhig yod par/ de'i snga rol tsam zhig nas thams cad mthun par chos lugs dga' ldan par gyur/

rtogs ldan nam mkha' legs pas bzhugs pa'i rab bkram sgang 'dir/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob mnga' ris tshul khrims 'od zer pas shar gling nub gling gnyis yod pa'i dgon sde zhig btab mod kyi ring por ma lon par sa g.yos kyis nyams pa grag go /gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan gyi dbon po rgyal lu zhes bya ba yongs shos su yod par tshur slebs/ zur 'dug par bgros nas sing gi mkhar nag po dgra 'dul zhes bya ba brtsigs nas der bzhugs/ rgyal lu'i rigs sras su a 'phrag dang 'brug rgyal zhes pa gnyis byung*/ a 'phrag las rigs sras ldan shod kyi dpon tshe dbang 'phrag dang*/ dran thang drung rgod ma zhes pa karma pa'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa zhig dang*/ mgo zi'i khang dmar gyi bdag po nang so sangs rgyas legs spun gnyis te bzhi byung ngo*// gling drung pa ting 'dzin bzang po zhes pa dbas pa'i phru mar bkrongs/ de'i sha 'khon gyi lan nang so sangs rgyas legs pas blangs mod kyi nang so rang yang der bkums/ 'brug rgyal las gling chos 'phen rgyal dang drung pa kun dga' 'phags pa ste rigs sras gnyis 'khrungs/ phyi ma ni ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub pa las rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por bsgrubs nas thugs sras kyi thu bor gyur/ mkhan po chen po de nyid kyi bkas lung bstan rjes su gnang ba ltar chos sde dgon pa nye bar bskrun pa'i sta gon bsgrigs/ de'ang dgon pa sa'i cha gang du gdab pa legs 'gyur brtag pa/ sing gi bya brang mgo dang khas thang mgo gnyis su legs lam ma shar bar/ slar ngor chen thams cad gzigs pa'i zhal sngar gnas gzhi gang du byas pa legs 'gyur gsol ba na/ sa phyogs gang zhig sha ba'i bu mos she'u sbas pa ltar 'byung ba zhig tu dgon pa brgyab na legs pa'i bka' lung stsal/ de lta bu 'byung ba'i sa gzhi de btsal bas da lta'i sa gzhi 'di nyid du yin pa gdon mi za bar thag chod/

de nas rab byung brgyad pa'i 'gal byed ces pa lcags phag lor gnas zhing sgor mo'i steng du chos sde'i gtsug lag khang gi rmang bting*/ de nas brtsams te tsho pa bcu bzhis gyang bslang ba nas bzung ste chos sde'i gnas dmar zhes su grags pa grwa khang drug cu dang bcas pa la zur rdzong bcu gcig gis bskor ba'i rnam pa can du slong ngo*// spyi don a thang pad+ma rgyal mtshan gyis zhing sgor sgor ldan zhes pa gnyis nas khal nyi shu'i sa dgon gzhir bcad pa dang btsugs shing sum cu'i khang shing bcas phul bar grwa khang bcu gsum gsar du bskrun/ de skabs chos sde drung chen dang rab bkram drung chung nam mkha' rin chen te drung pa rnam gnyis zhes mnga' thang dang phrin las shin tu rgyas par byung*/ ri rtsibs karma'i dgon gyi bla ma blo gros bzang po dang legs bshad a 'phan rgyal sogs pha bzhi kun dga' rin chen/ mkhar nang lhun grub rgyal mtshan/ byang sgo brtson 'grus/ bzhi ru lha lu thar/ sa phug chos 'byor/ bya ra'i lha rje skya sgang*/ spyi don a sngags/ ldan ma'i lha rje phun tshogs dpal ldan/ dud chen dgu po re res thub pa gnas brtan bcu drug dang grub brnyes brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i sku thang tshar re bzhengs zin pa dang gnas po'i ming 'dogs bgyis nas dgon pa'i spyi pa las sna gtad/ 'dus sde'i dbu mdzad rong pa bstan pa dar rgyas sogs las tshan gyi bsko gzhag stsal/ gang gi tshe bstan srid gtsug lag gi rnam gzhag dar rgyas shin tu che bar gyur to// chos 'phen rgyal gyi sras chos sde drung pa bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ chos skyong g.yul rgyal/ chos phyug ces bya ba ste gsum mo// nam zhig na tshe dbang 'phrag drung rgod pa/ drung pa kun dga' 'phags pa/ chos 'phen rgyal bzhi po gnyen mtshams nang blo ma mthun pa'i stabs kyis g.yul shom par/ gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan la sogs pa ming mthar rgyal mtshan thogs pa bdun gyis bar 'dums legs par mdzad/

de skabs shig nas dpal sa skya'i lha khang bla brang pa 'chi med 'od gsal rigs kyi gdung brgyud 'jam pa'i dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya ba/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā'i thugs sras dam par gyur pa de nyid ljongs 'di'i sems can rnams kyi legs byas dman pa min pa'i mgron skal du legs par phebs/ 'dam thog dang ldan yul phyogs kyi bstan srid zung 'brel gyi jus ka thams cad bzung*/ zhi ba ste sa mo bya lor 'bri klung dal gyis 'bab ma'i pha rol 'dir yul gyi dge bcu phun sum tshogs par gzigs nas sa dkar bsam 'grub gling zhes bya ba'i chos sde btab ste mkhar dkar po dang dmar por grags pa zung bslangs so// dmar po'i gtsug lag khang gi ldebs ris kyi lha thams cad legs bshad sangs rgyas lha dbang pa khu dbon kho nas phyag bris bstar ba da lta'ang kun las khyad par 'phags par bzhugs pa 'di yin/ mkhar dkar po'i gser gdung khang du'ang zhing khams bzhi'i bkod pa phyag bris su bstar ba 'khrul med kho bo cag yan gyis mjal du mchis so// slar yang bdag chen rin chen rgyal mtshan pa de nyid kyis/ srin bu zhes pa shing yos kyi gnam lo shar ba na/ 'bri klung chen po'i tshu rol du rag co rnam rgyal dgon zhes bya ba'i chos sde 'di nyid btab ste bla brang mkhar dkar po grwa khang dang bcas pa bskrun/ rag co chos skyong 'bum zhes bya bas dad gus chen pos nas khal bzhi bcu lhag tsam 'gro ba'i sa zhing phul ba da lta sa skya'i 'bul sdud pa la yod/ chos skyong g.yul rgyal dang rab bkram drung pa nam mkha' bsod nams a thang skyar/ ngag chu chos skyong bkra shis/ mgon pa kun dar/ bzhi ru kun dar/ sogs kyis gang ci'i zhabs 'bring legs par bsgrubs/ rag co dang*/ skyur sogs ra mda'i tshe brtan/ 'od gsal pad+ma rgyal mtshan/ gnas po'i sar bzhag rnam dkar phrin las kyi 'khor los phyogs bral du bgrod par gyur/

nam zhig rag co rnam rgyal dgon gyi logs bris ma grub pa'i mtshams nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pa 'dam thog dgon du bzhugs pa'i skabs der/ bstan pa'i gegs rkyen stobs su bdo bas sku khams ma snyoms par dga' ldan mi pham mgon po'i zhabs drung du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to// de rjes shig nas chab mdo chos rje kun dga' dpal ldan zhes bya ba zhig gis/ chos 'khor dgon du byon nas dgon pa nyams gso cung zad byas shing lo shas su zin/ de mtshams sku drung bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas byon te jus srid thams cad tshur blangs nas bzung ngo*// de rjes chos 'khor bas zin pa lho phyogs nas gser mdog can pas 'ongs te phrogs/ chos 'khor khang steng du ru mtshon btsugs/ de rjes 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pa'i gcung kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i sras/ bdag chen 'jam dbyangs kun dga' blo gros legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes grags pa gzhon nu nas rab tu byung zhing gsar rnying yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal mthong ba de nyid ldan sa dkar la byon nas der bzhugs/ nyin yug min pa'i bstan jus thams cad bzung zhing bskyangs/ nyin phyogs nas legs bshad pa'i lha bzo sangs rgyas lha dbang pa sogs sa phug pa/ pha bzhi bu/ spyi don kun dga' legs pa rnams/ tshur blangs te zhing khang stsal nas las tshan pa dang*/ skyur gsol dpon gyi sar bkod pa sogs las byed kyi rnam gzhag rgyas shing stobs dang phrin las dar rgyas su gyur to// de ltar bdag chen rin po che nyid khams phyogs kyi bstan pa'i snang byed chen por gyur kyang sku na smin che bar bcas/ sa skyar sngags 'chang chen po'i zhabs drung du ljongs 'dir spyi sgos kyi bstan pa dang sems can la sman pa'i phyir du gdung sras zhig cis kyang 'byon dgos tshul gsol bar de ltar legs tshul dang*/ 'on yang bdag chen nyid gdan sa 'dir mi ring bar spyon cig dang de dus zhib gsal 'ong tshul gyi bka' lan phebs/

ji ltar gsungs don ltar 'di nas gdan sar bteg pa'i lam bar du 'gyangs ches bas sngags 'chang chen po zhing khams gzhan du gshegs nas zhal mjal ma thub/ 'on kyang 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po sku mched dang mjal/ der sngar gyi zhu 'phros rnams phul bar/ dus mchod bla brang gi gdung brgyud 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams mthu stobs dbang phyug pa sku 'khor du bcas pa brdzang pa dang lhan cig tu byon te/ sa dkar dang 'dam thog gi bzhugs gnas su gdan phab ste/ mdo khams phyogs su 'gro don shin tu rgyas par byung*/ glang lor 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug pas sa skyar phebs/ der yun ring ma bzhugs par/ slar stag lor khams phyogs su phebs pa'i lam du 'gro don la g.yengs pas 'gor che ba byung*/ khams kyi sa'i cha zin par phebs tsam na/ bdag chen kun dga' blo gros legs pa'i 'byung gnas pa chos sde drung pa/ kun dga' 'phags pa snyung tshabs kyis sku lus shin tu lji bar byung ba der spyan 'dren byas par byon pas dbang bka' sogs kyis bzhed pa bskang*/ mi ring bar drung pa chen po'i gzugs sku chos dbyings zab mo'i klong du mnyam par gzhag bdag rkyen rin po che sa dkar gyi gdan sar phebs 'phral nas sku khams mi bde ba'i bro 'tshal/ de lta'i gnas tshul mthu stobs pa'i snyan dbang du son 'phral nas rings par byon pas bdag chen pa'i zhal mjal/ mthu stobs par bstan pa la 'dzin skyong dgos tshul gyi dus tha ma'i bslab bya stsal nas/ bdag chen nyid dgung lo don bdun pa me 'brug lo hor zla bdun pa'i nyer lnga la gzugs sku'i bkod pa zung 'jug bde chen chos sku'i dbyings su brtul pa'i tshul bstan no// de nas sgar chen mthu stobs pas pur sbyangs dang gser gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po can du bzhengs shing lo shas su bzhugs/ slar sog yul dang dar rtse mdo dang chen chun go bo rgya skyegs sogs su byon nas slar nye phyogs su phebs pa na/

'di phyogs shig nas jus srid be ris phrogs pa ltar bsgrags pa/ sgar chen pas gsan 'phral dpyad pas ma zhugs par dbus gtsang la log nas byon/ 'jam yas dang gtsang pas 'dam thog bzung nas skad ngan shod mkhan yang de gnyis byas/ sgar chen pas lha ldan sogs su brgyud de rim gyis byon/ sa skyar sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams dang zhal mjal legs par mdzad de/ ring zhig nas sku mya ngan las 'das so// yang lho'i cha nas dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje bya bas byung nas des kyang jus dbyar ngo zhig zin/ yang gling dang be ris zin res byung ba'i mtshams der/ ma hā tsi na'i yul nas sa skya'i grwa tshang chos rje zhes bya ba zhig gis phebs nas jus thams cad sa skyas bzung*/ rab bkram drung pa blo gros rnam rgyal dgon pa khag gnyis gnas dmar po dang bcas pa'i bdag por bskos te bka' shog bcas gnang nas bzung bas lo gnyis zin/ de mtshams su gling tshang gis bzung lo byas/ de mthar jus yongs rdzogs be ris bzung*/ dbus gtsang gi phyogs ni gtsang pa rgyal pos zin pa'i skabs so// be ri'i dpon klu btsan dang a 'phen rgyal zhes bya ba byung nas/ ldan yul chos 'khor sogs su bsti gnas bgyis/ phyi ma'i bu don yod rgyal zhes bya bas chos 'khor dgon du lha khang dkar mo zhes pa bskrun/ thog mar dpon de chos la dad mos che ba zhig ste/ lha khang de'i nang du ldeb ris la yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems la sogs pa'i snang brnyan rnams bzheng pa'i lha bris pa rta mgrin mgon po'i phyag bris stsal ba sha stag tu mchis shing*/ der pha a 'phen rgyal gyi lus tshad dang mnyam par bcal ba'i dngul dkar 'byams brdungs las grub pa'i/ 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po'i sku brnyan khyad 'phags kyis mtshon pa'i rten bzheng ba sogs chos mthun gyi bya ba bgyis/ be ri'i dpon rgan de snang zhig bon po zhes bya ba yid srubs snying la zhugs pa'i 'tshe ba bon du smra ba zhig gis bslus nas log pa'i lam du zhugs/

ldan glang thang du bon po'i dgon pa bzo ba'i gzhi yangs par gyang brdung ba dang mi dge ba'i spyod pa mang po lhur len par byas/ chos 'khor dpon gyi thog ma ni sga stod phyogs nas rang bzhin gyis 'ongs pa kun dga' rnam rgyal zhes bya ba zhig byung ste/ des chos 'khor lung pa'i sa jus dum bu zhig gi bdag po byung bas chos 'khor dpon zhes grags/ de nas rim par chos 'khor dpon rgan zhes pa dang*/ 'ba' yu dang*/ khri thogs pa dang*/ rta mgrin dbang drag ces pa rnams byung*/ phyi ma de dag mdzangs ldan zhig yod par grag mod/ de skabs chos 'khor dbon po ser po zhes bya ba'i las byed pa ngan g.yo can zhig yod pa des bsam ngan dbang gis ja nang du dug btab nas thugs nang gshin pa'i tshul gyis ja 'dren pa zhig btang bar/ 'dren pas de ltar ma shes par/ bi ri dpon dang rang gi dpon gnyis ka 'dzom thog tu sri zhu byas pas las ngan gyi lad mos rta mgrin dbang drag can gyi zhal du thim pas de'i rkyen gyis dus byas/ ldan gyi 'bam le dgon dang gnyen chu kha'i nyen skor gyi jus bla ma sangs rgyas gnyen pas bdag tu bzung nas yod pa la/ phyis su gnyen bde legs phun tshogs zhes bya ba'i skabs su/ dbon po ser pos bi ṣa brgyud nas 'drong du bcug pas grongs pa dang sa jus chos 'khor dpon gyis bzung ngo*// gzhan yang chos 'khor dpon la gzungs lu/ ngag dbang las tshogs/ grags pa dbang phyug ces pa rim gyis byung ngo*// sog po hong tha'i ji la rgya nag pas gu shi hang zhes pa'i ming gnang*/ sog po 'phying gur can dang 'brog pa sbra nag ka ba btsugs so cog de la gnang ste dpon por bskos/ stod chu dmar nas dbus phyogs su bteg pa na bod kyi dpon po rnams mjal du song tshe/ des bi ri rgyal pos chos min gyi las byas par shes nas bzung*/ bka' bkyon phab ste jus phrogs/ kho rang chab mdor khrims 'og tu las ngan gsog pa'i lus rten gyi 'tsho ba'i 'du byed btang bar grags so// de skabs shig na ldan yul 'bri chu pha rol tshu rol gyi jus las chos 'khor ba/

ka bzhi ba/ mkhar dmar ba/ tshe bh+rūm̐ pa/ rab bkram drung pa/ mgo zi khra leb dbon po ste drug gis lo gsum tsam du bskyangs/ de rjes sog po rta khra can pas bzung tshul tsam dang*/ sog po kho shus chi dang mkha' 'gro can rnams kyis kyang gzung lo re byas/ de nas btsan phyug gnyis kyis zin/ de mtshams dbang phyug ces pa me glang lor rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho al than rgyal pos gdan drangs par chibs bsgyur gnang bas bod khams yongs kyi bla mar mnga' gsol/ yar lam zhwa lu legs pa rgyal mtshan pa'i thugs sras/ nyag re rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis btab pa'i dgon pa chos 'khor la byon nas chos gsungs pa sogs/ bstan don mdzad de dbus su bteg de nyid dang bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po mchod yon du 'brel pa'i legs lam yar ngo'i zla ba ltar rgyas par gyur/ gzhung sa'i sku tshab rnams kyis 'ongs nas 'bri klung gdags sribs kyi sde rtsis btab nas chos 'khor ba shogs gnyis dang*/ ka bzhi ba shogs gcig tu bgo bshar bgyis/ 'bri chu srib mor chos 'khor ba dang sa dkar ba grub mthar zhen rtsod kyis ma 'grigs par chos 'khor bas sa skya'i gser gdung bshig pa dang dmag dpung gis dgon par bskor ba sogs mi 'tsham pa byas/ mtsho sngon nas sog po o jus nu yon gyis byon nas legs 'dums bcad par/ sa dkar bas dpon gyi sku rim du tshe dpag med kyi cho ga nyi ma bdun 'tshogs pa dang*/ sde shogs gcig gi khral dgos pa de'i yon 'bul du stob pa'i yon mchod bzang por bsgrigs nas zur slong mi chog pa'i bka' tham bcas gnang*/ nam zhig na rgyal po hong tha'i ji dus chos su thim du nye ba na 'bri klung gdags sribs kyi mnga' ris rnams bu chung shos er tan tha'i jis bgo skal du nos/ skabs shig tu 'bri klung nyin mo 'dir sku drung rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' sangs rgyas dang*/

drung pa ye shes 'bum la sogs pas gtsos pa'i bla dgon rnams dang*/ ka bzhi dpon yab sras ma mthun pa'i gleng zlos mang du byung bar shar gling gnas pos bar 'dums bgyis nas slad char dgon pas rta 'ur mi dgos par ched/ gya rog tha'i ji'i sku ring la gdan sa gong nas shrī sa skya pa ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug dpal bzang po nas sde dge khri chen par mdo khams phyogs kyi dgon sde rnams kyi mgo 'dren gnyer gtams ma 'phyugs pa'i bka' lung gi glegs bu phyag rgya pad+ma rā ga'i 'khor los sgeg pa stsal bar brten/ zla bral stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba sde dge sa skyong bla ma chen po khri chen sangs rgyas bstan pa nas dgon pa gong 'og gnyis bdag gir mdzad/ sa skyong chen po'i bka' lung gi kha lo sgyur chen dge slong chos skyong blo gros kyis ljongs 'dir phebs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed drug cu pa dang rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i sgrub mchod btsugs pa sogs legs byas kyi sgo 'phar phye/ chos dang srid pa'i gtsug lag gi 'dren byed dkyus su ring ba a dran dge slong phrin las phun tshogs pas dgon sde gtsang dgon du bsgrub pa dang*/ ngor lugs dkyil 'khor chen po dbang po'i grangs ldan gyi sgrub mchod dang*/ chos skyong che chung gi sgrub rgyun 'dzugs pa sogs bstan srid kyi legs srol bskal par mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan bslangs/ rab byung nyi ma'i chu yos kyi gnam lor bsod nams gnam gyis bskos pa shar phyogs gong ma chen po zhes grags pa gang gis rdzu 'phrul thog brgya phab pa lta bu'i dmag dpung bskyed pas mtsho sngon phyogs su 'khod pa'i sa bdag gi tshogs chen po rnams rmeg med du bcil te/ gong ma'i phrin las gser gyi tsakras bho ṭa'i yul gyi nor 'dzin yangs pa'i bzhin ras khyab par nyul ba na/ de'i las lung gi kha lo pa khri gdugs dā log yes kyis gtsang dbus khams gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad gnam bskos chen po'i lhag bsam gdung skyob dkar po'i grib mar ngal gsor spyod du bcug

gang gi tshe mdo khams phyogs su 'khod dgu'i skye 'gro'i bde sdug dang legs nyes dpyod pa'i 'jig rten mes po lta bu de khyod sde dges byed dgos tshul gyi bka' lung sa skyong bstan pa tshe ring par stsal to// ring zhig nas sde dge'i mdun na 'don chen po chos skyong blo gros pa'i tsha bo zhig chos 'khor dbon chung gis bsad pa'i rtsod gzhi byung bar/ sde dge bstan pa tshe ring nas bar 'dums bcad par/ chos 'khor bas sa dkar gyi sa skya'i gser gdung chen po lha khang bcas chos skyong blo gros la byin nas 'jags bder byas so// de rjes su lha sras bar pa sde dge bla chen kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde nyid/ gnam bskos shar phyogs gong ma chen po'i bka' lung gis gser tham chen po gnang skyes gya nom dang bcas pas/ sde dge sa skyong gi gser khri chen po la dbang bskur te 'gro ba spyi'i rje bor gyur to// ring zhig nas rgya rong rgyal po nyag rong pa dag shar phyogs gong ma'i mnga' 'og tu ma gus par rang dgar bsgyings pa la rgya dmag chen po gshar ba'i dus su/ bod dbus gtsang man chad kyi mi dpon rnams la'ang dmag g.yar byung skabs/ sde dge nas dmag dpung chen pos gong ma'i zhabs phyi g.yo sgyu med par bsgrubs pas thugs dgyes che ba byung ngo*// slar yang ring zhig nas smar 'grims grong nas mi gsar zhes pa zhig gis sa skyong bsod nams mgon po la mgo gtad byas pa/ de'i nyes chad lta bu'i sde nang de nas mi srun 'ga' zhig gis mi gsar gyi spun zla zhig bsad/ kho rang yang gsod grabs shom par bros nas thar bar brten/ chos 'khor dpon la sa skyong gi dgongs 'phog byung*/ de'i tshe sde dge khri chen bla mas bar 'dums mdzad de/ smar 'grims mi sde kha shas sa skyong la dbul du bcug nas 'jags bder mdzad/ 'on kyang legs 'dums de la cung zad ma rangs pa'i rgyus/

sde dge dang chos 'khor dpon sngar zhang dbon nang gtsang yin mod/ de mtshams nas sde dge la dgra zlar bzung nas gyod bskul gyis yar 'gro mar 'gro mang bzhin byas mthar/ sa skyong nas dmag dum nyung shas bkye bas chos 'khor dpon blon rnams bzung nas khrims la sbyar nye bar/ ngor gyi mkhan chen thams cad gzigs pa dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa chos kyi bar 'dums la byon/ sa skyong chen po'ang ljongs 'dir phebs thog ldan gling char 'khod kyi bla dpon dgon sder bcas pa thams cad kyis slad char ci gsungs bsgrub par khas blangs zol med kyi thal sbyar btud pa'i zhu 'bul bgyis thog bcad par/ smar 'grims mi sde dang sa dkar gyi sa skya'i gnas zhing ye 'byor chen po dang*/ se ba'i bu'i zhing khang sogs sa skyong gis phyag bzhes mdzad de/ phyin chad snyad slong med par lus srog gi nyes chad las bde bar bkrol lo// sngon dus ldan ma'i phyogs kyi dgon sde'i mgo 'dzin dang dgon pa zung gi lo dar gyi 'dzugs dgos dang kha mchu gtam ched/ mkhar mdo pho brang nas dge bshes phrin las phun tshogs pa 'byon pa'i srol mchis pa ltar/ 'di dag gi skabs su'ang de'i dbon dge bshes bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dang kun dga' blo gros khu dbon ldan yul stod smad kyi sde dgon rnams kyi bde sdug brtag pa'i sger dpon du bskos nas sa dkar chos sde sogs su bzhugs res kyis/ dpal sde dge chos rgyal chen po'i bstan srid rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi kha lo gang zhig phyogs nas phyogs dang khor yug nas khor yug tu 'dren pa la su yang rung ba'i bsdo bas rnam par dben pa'i mkhyen dpyod kyi skya rengs gzhon nu'i bgrod pa mi dman pa'i ring nas/ ldan yul phyogs kyi chos sde mtha' dag dang*/ sgos su dgon pa gong 'og sa dkar du bcas pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams kyi bsnyen bkur 'bul nod kyi ched du rang gi bdog dgu'i dngos po ci tsam song yang rjes su yi rang gi snying stobs kyi rgya mtsho nam yang bri ba mi mnga' zhing*/

khyad par mig dmar te shing pho byi ba'i lor chos sde 'dir/ dpal sa skya'i zab mdos chen po'am dmar chen gtor bzlog tu grags pa sngon med gsar du btsugs te/ de la nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad zhal 'bag dang 'chams chas la sogs pa'ang chos grwa chen po gnyis su 'gran zlar bzod pa 'di dag dang*/ gtsug lag khang du phye ma phur ma che legs cha dang bla re la sogs pa mchod rdzas rang gis gsar bskrun gyi rnam pa mang du bstabs pa sogs dang bcas te/ da ltar bzhugs bzhin pa 'di nyid do// smras pa/ nyi ma'i

rab brtags las ting nge 'dzin gyi rab rtog gnyen bstan ring 'tsho'i byin rlabs kyi// legs bris btung ba 'bum phrag skyugs 'thungs la// kun dga' khong nas 'dzum pa'i nor ldan ma// rang lus shis pa'i dkyil 'khor sprul lam snyam// dngos po nges bstan las mchog gi nges bstan/ 'phrog byed sgeg mo 'jos pa'i zil dngar de// phal pa'i snod las 'phyan pa dam pa'i chos// 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i nor ldan ma min pa// yul 'gas theg par mi nus smra bar mtshon// yan lag gcig gzugs can/ de na srid las ring po'i mkhar 'phags pa// gang gi thugs rje'i gdugs dkar lding khongs su// rgyal phran bye ba rgyur bcas bde ba la// dgyes dgur rtsen pa'i ga zha 'brug tu 'byin// bsdus par brjod pa/ bar skabs sngo bsangs dus kyi mel tshe mar// rang lus dang 'tsham mal du gnyid yur ba'i// rmi lam bus pa skye 'chi'i dga' sdug gis// cher myos rnam 'gyur ltad mo brjod mi long*// yan lag gsum pa'i gzugs can/ de nang rgyal bstan rin chen 'byung gnas su// bshad sgrub mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'bum brdung ba'i// bstan skyong ngur pa'i phreng ba yongs sdud pa'i// chos ldan mi bdag de dag bsngags pa'i 'os// zhes gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i gleng ba kun dga'i 'dzum zer 'dzag pa'i zla gzhon las gang du bskrun pa'i gnas kyi sarga ste dang po'o// //spyi don gnyis pa der ji ltar bskrun pa la/ rten gtsug lag khang ji ltar bskrun pa/ brten pa rten gsum ji ltar bskrun pa'o// dang po la'ang nyer bsdogs bsgrigs pa dang*/ dngos gzhi brtsam pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyir kun dga' rwa ba dang gtsug lag khang brtsig pa lhur blangs pas rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun thob par 'gyur te/ 'dul ba lung du/ kun dga' rwa ba gtsug lag khang*// mal stan 'tsho ba nar ma dang*// glo bur nad pa'i nad g.yog dang*// yul ngan tshe na sbyin pa ni// rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun// zhes so// de dag sdig pa'i rgyu yin no zhes smra ba ni mu stegs gcer bu ba rjes su 'jug pa dang bcas pa'i lugs te/

khyad par 'phags pa'i bstod par/ gcer bu kun dga' rwa ba sogs// brtsegs pa sdig pa'i rgyu zhes zer// thams cad mkhyen pa khyod nyid ni// de nyid bsod nams rgyu zhes gsungs// zhes so// de'ang rang re'i ston pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'di la/ thog mar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ wā rā ṇā sī'i khyim bdag dge bzang la chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis yang dag par rab tu dga' bar mdzad pa na/ des gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gal te gnang na/ 'di ltar bdag gis bcom ldan 'das nyan thos su bcas pa bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang brtsig par bgyi lags so// bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag de lta bas na rjes su gnang gis rtsigs shig ces bka' stsal te/ brtsigs pa dge bzang gi gtsug lag khang zhes bya ba 'di ni gtsug lag khang kun gyi snga bar byung ngo*// de nas bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos de bzhin gshegs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas/ rgyal po'i khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i bzhugs gnas su phul bar 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan+ta ka'i gnas zhes bya ba dang*/ mnyan yod kyi khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis/ rgyal bu'am gzhon nu las sa gzhi gser gyis yogs par bkram ste bcal ba der gtsug lag khang brtsigs nas bcom ldan 'das la phul ba rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal/ mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' rwa ba sogs rim gyis byung ngo*// rab bsil kha ba'i rdul brtsegs kyi rwa ba dkar pos bskor ba'i bod yul sman gyi ljongs 'dir/ chos ldan gyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pas thog drangs te/ rten dang brten pa'i ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa bgrang las 'das pa legs bris lam du rgyu skar phreng ba bkrag pa ltar bod dang bod chen po la sogs pa/ phyogs dang phyogs bral gyi tha gru yangs pa'i gser ldan gyi dkyil 'khor phal cher khengs pa byung ngo*// des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' lung gi rjes su zhugs shing rjes su bsgrub par 'dod pa'i blo gros kyi chu gter chen po gang las dge ba'i rlabs phreng yol med srid pa'i rtse mor lud pa snyam byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring du dar ba dang*/

'jig rten gyi khams su phan bde 'byung ba'i phyir du tshul 'di dag la 'bad pa kun gyi rtse mo lta bur lhur bgyis pa de bzhin du/ 'dir yang stobs bcu mnga' ba bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs bla nas bla mar 'degs pa la bsnyengs pa med pa'i snying stobs kyi phrag pa rab tu brling bar byas pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po/ dpal sde dge sa skyong bla ma kun dga' phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde zhes grags pa'i zla snang dkar pos phyogs kyi lus phra'i bzhin ras 'gengs pa gang der/ mkhyen dpyod kyi mig dkyus thung ngur ma gyur pa'i zham ring ba dge slong bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis gang ci'i gtam gyi rgyud mangs 'khrol ba'i zhar las/ ldan yul chos sde'i gnas dmar por grags pa 'di'i shod kyi gtsug lag khang ni dgon pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs khang yin pa dang*/ steng khang ni ka bzhi dpon gyis bdag gir bgyis pas/ da lta yang khang rgan 'gyel nyen che ba zhig tu mchis mod/ phan tshun bsam blo ma mnyam pas thag khrar sbrul mthong lta bur ci bgyir ma shes par lus pa'i gnas tshul snyan gyi dbang por phul bar/ khri chen bla ma nyid thugs dgyes pa'i 'dzum zer dkar po ngom bzhin par/ de lta na spyir nged kyis par khang pa'i chos yon byung ba'i dngos rdzas 'di sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i rten gsum bzheng pa dang gtsug lag khang gsar bskrun bgyid pa sogs kyi rgyu rkyen du btang ba'i zhar byung yin gshis/ de gar yang khyod khu tshas las 'gan gyi do dam par byos la/ gtsug lag khang rnying pa gshegs su gsol nas/ de'i shul du gsar bskrun zhig grub na legs tshul gyi bslab bya rgyas par stsal ba'i mthar/ gan+dho la'i gzugs dang bzo dbyibs bcas pa'i shog dpe zhib gsal stsal to// gang gi tshe ji ltar bka' lung rin po che gser gyi cod paṇa mgo bo'i rgyan du thob pa yar ldog mi spobs pa ma zad/

legs par grub pa zhig byung na rang rgyud la'ang bsod nams kyi phung po nye bar gsog pa'i rgyur nges mod/ dge bshes rang nyid bgrang gzhi'i grangs kyi khur bu lci ba'i khar/ snyung gzhi che bas las 'gan ma theg pa'i dogs pa shin tu che ba mchis rung bzhed don gang 'grub bgyid par khas 'ches pa las 'os ma rnyed/ de mthun par dpon dge slong don grub nas kyang snga phyir dngos rdzas gya nom pa'i gtong ba mi zad pa'i sgo 'phar phye ba stsal/ de'ang thog mar sa phyogs rang dbang du chod pa zhig ma byung na mi btub ste/ dus kyi 'khor lor/ gang na sa phyogs chos ldan zhing*// gang zhig kho nar skye dgu rnams// bder gnas sa 'dzin rtsod med pa// gnas der rnal 'byor brtsam par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar gang du brtsam pa'i gzhi ma rang dbang du bgyid slad/ ka bzhi dpon la ris bral skye dgu'i skyabs gcig mkhan po chen po dpal ldan chos skyong pas legs 'dums bar bzhugs pa'i sgo nas gnang sbyin khang tshab bcas stsal te/ sa gzhi mngon pa'i bdag po las nye bar bslang ba bcas nyer bsdogs kyi cho ga dang po nye bar brtsams so// gnyis pa la/ brtsam pa'i dus dang*/ rtsom pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyir rtsom pa kun la dus nges par brjod pa ni/ dran pa'i dbang po rnams dgyes par rol pa'i chu gter du 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ gza' sogs tshes dge bas ni mngon 'dod 'bras bu bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ba'i phyir nam brtsams pa'i dus brjod de/ de la bdag cag gi ston pa bla med nyi ma'i gnyen gyi 'khrungs lo sogs la bzhed pa mi 'dra ba mang du mchis mod/ 'dir dpal ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pas shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa dang smra ba'i dbang phyug grub pa chen po dpal sa skya pa rnams kyis/ lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas bsnyad na/

stod 'grel gyi skad du rnam byung zhes pa sa 'brug gi lo la/ skyed byed dam pa zas gtsang gi sras su 'jig rten thams cad snang ba chen po'i 'od kyis rgyas par 'gengs pa dang chabs cig bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas te bkra shis lum+bi ni'i tshal du mngon par bltams pa nas brtsams/ da lta'i gtsug lag khang brtsig pa'i gnam lo lcags lug 'di yan chad du bgrang gzhi sum stong dgu brgya re gsum 'das shing*/ dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga pa chu stag gi lo'i sa ga zla ba'i nya la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ brgyad cur son par mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan nas lo sum stong brgyad brgya gya bzhi sngon du brgal lo// me mo yos lor lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi sku ring la kha ba'i ljongs 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes nas chig stong sum brgya gya bzhi 'das pa dang*/ chu glang lor bod yul dbus kyi rdo rje gdan dam pa lha ldan 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang chen po btab nas zla ba'i phung po stong dang go brgyad sngon du brgal ba dang*/ chu glang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing gi rgyal po gang de gangs can pa'i bsod nams mgron du khugs pa snyam bgyid pa'i dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po btab nas bgrang gzhi drug brgya bdun cu rtsa brgyad sngon du song ba dang*/ chu pho sprel lor 'phags pa phyag na pad+mas mtshan pa'i lha mchog skye 'gro'i rgya mtsho rdo rje 'chang gi sar 'khrid pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug sa skya pa kun dga' snying po zhes mkhas shing grub pa'i rnga bo che/ srid pa gsum gyi khongs su ldir ba gang de gtsang la stod grom par sku 'khrungs nas lo drug brgya dang drug cu rtsa gnyis brgal ba dang*/ rnga chen chu khyir kun mkhyen chos kyi snang byed dam par dri bral lung gi dbang pos bsngags pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po kun dga' bzang po zhes bya ba/

deng dus kyi yid can thar pa'i lam mkhan du sku mngon par bltams nas bgrang bya sum brgya re brgyad brgal ba dang*/ rab byung ri bo'i sa mo bya lor theg gsum dam pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs rtag par sgrogs pa'i bod yul gyi badz+rā sa na e waṃ chos ldan gyi chos grwa chen po btab nas sum brgya nyer gnyis 'das shing*/ rab byung nor lha'i sa mo bya lor 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgyu 'phrul rol pa rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sa dkar gyi dgon sde btab nas lo grangs nyis brgya re gnyis brgal zhing*/ de la gnyis kyis dman par brgal bar lcags phag la 'dul ba 'dzin mchog drung chen kun dga' 'phags pas chos sde dgon pa legs par btab pa dang*/ shing yos lor 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos rat+na dh+wa dza'i zhabs kyis rag co rnam rgyal dgon btab nas nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug 'das pa'i bgrang gzhi/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos rin po che 'dzam bu rkang 'thung gi dbang pos mtshan pa'i gling 'dir lo lnga stong du gnas par mkhas pa rnams la yongs su grags shing lung gis legs par grub pa de las/ ston pas me phag gi lo mdzad pa tha ma bstan pa'i lugs kyi dus de nas brtsams/ deng dus gtsug lag khang 'di ga bskrun pa'i 'go brtsams pa yan chad du 'bras bu'i dus gsum dang*/ sgrub pa'i dus gsum ste stong phrag gsum dang*/ lung gi dus gsum las mngon pa'i dus lnga brgya phrag gcig dang*/ mdo sde'i dus kyi lnga brgya phrag gcig las sum brgya gya bzhi ste/ thams cad bsdoms par sum stong brgyad brgya gya bzhi sngon du brgal lo// lhag ma chig brgya bcu drug dang*/ 'dul ba'i dus kyi lnga brgya phrag gcig dang*/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus kyi lnga brgya phrag gcig bcas/ 'byung 'gyur bstan pa'i lhag ma chig stong chig brgya bcu drug mchis pa'i gsar tshes kyi gnam lo/

rab byung 'dod pa'i gnam lo'i nang gses kyi ming du legs sbyar skad du pra dza pa ti/ stod 'grel las 'byung ba gangs can pa'i skad du skye dgu'i bdag po/ gtsug lag spor thang dang mthun par ma hā tsi na'i rgyal khab tu zin 'u'i ra bod pa/ 'tsho ba dang lus ni nor gyi blo gros ma'i rang bzhin du brling ba/ dbang thang sra mkhregs lcags kyi ya lad stug por bgos pa/ klung ni mun sel 'od kyi nor can gyi ska rags kyis nye bar spud pa/ rgyal khab gling dgu'i lto bar yab lha gdal drug me long gi rang bzhin rab tu brling ba'i 'byung ba sum ldan/ srog dbang ma bur gyur pa'i se zhig gi lo/ mtshan mo'i mgon gyi klung dang ldan pa ste/ dbang thang dang bstun pa'i btags ming du lcags mo lug zhes grags pa'i gnam lo shar ba'i dus rgyu skar gyi bu mo dbos nya ba'i zhag gi phung po'i dmar phyogs kyi nyi shu dgu'i tshes la/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa nyid nas rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral lha brgyad dang stobs 'phrog dbang po'i sku brnyan drag rtsal can rnams la gtor 'bul dang bka' bsgo phrin las bcol bar bcas pas rol mo mchod pa'i phreng ba dag dang lhan cig tu bzhugs gnas gzhan du spyan 'dren mdzad pa sngon du btang*/ de nyin nas brtsams 'u lag pa rnams kyis lha khang gi phyi khyams bshig bskyas kyi 'go tshugs/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ rgya mthongs dang*/ lam 'bras khang dang*/ gzims chung dang*/ mgon khang rnams kyi ldebs ris rnying pa shin tu mang po bzhugs pa rnams kyi ye shes pa 'byin chog sogs bdag la dgos tshul mchod yon zung nas bkas gnang ltar/ ar+gha'i cho ga'i nyer bsdogs snyan gsan dbab pa dang*/ dngos gzhi ye shes pa 'byin pa'i cho ga rnams bla ma gong ma'i yig cha tshad ldan gyi brjod bya dang rjes su mthun par kho bo cag dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug bzang po bkra shis la sogs pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi las la 'os pa brgyad kyis bgyis so// de'ang steng shod kyi lha khang 'di rnams sngon dus mkhas grub bla ma mang pos rab gnas dang chos skyong rnams la gnyer gtad yang yang bgyis pa gor ma chag pa dang*/

rang dgar 'phyan pa'i gnas bdag 'byung po gdug pa can gyis bdag gir bzung ba'i lha khang gog po shin tu gnyan che ba mchis mod/ gong smos ltar mkhan po thams cad mkhyen pa nas phrin las bcol ba dang gegs bral gyi gnang ba nod pa'i byin rlabs sogs la brten/ bshig dbral sogs kyi skabs su gang la'ang nyer 'tshe phra mo yang ma byung bar thams cad ngo mtshar du brtsi ba byung ngo*// de nas gong du smos pa'i gnam lo de'i rta bdun dbang po'i bgrod pa gnyis las/ dge legs phyogs kyi brtsams pa thams cad la bkra shis par ster ba byang phyogs gnod sbyin gyi bdag pos legs par bsrungs pa'i phyogs su bgrod pa'i dus so// zla ba bcu gnyis las rgyu skar sa gas yongs su nya ba'i zhag gi phung po/ dus 'khor lugs kyi dbyar rwa ba/ rten 'brel reg pa'i zla ba/ pad+ma'i gnyen gyi dkyil 'khor khyu mchog gi khyim du rtsen pa'i dus/ zla ba'i bdag po pa wa sangs/ hor lugs dang gso ba rig pa dgongs mthun gyi zla ba bzhi pa/ gtsug lag spor thang lugs kyi dbyar tha chung*/ phug khyung mkhas pa rjes 'brang bcas pa'i nag rtsis pa'i lugs la me lug dang*/ hor lugs sogs nag rtsis pa phal cher shing sbrul du bzhed pa'i zla ba gang de'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa/ dus 'khor ba'i lugs la dbyangs ha/ gsal byed ḍha/ 'byung ba nam mkha'/ 'dod yon sgra/ dbyangs 'char ba'i lugs kyi dbyangs a/ gsal byed wa/ 'byung ba sa/ 'dod yon dri/ gnyis ka mthun pa'i dar gud byis pa/ nyi ma sa'i khams dang ldan pa'i rta mchog spar kha li/ sme ba brgyad dkar/ res gza' lha'i bla ma/ gtsug lag spor thang gi dgongs par rags par zla ba dang zhib pa phur bu dar ba/ grub rtsis rjes 'brangs rgyu skar phug ron/ 'phrod chen rtag myos/ khams 'phrod phun tshogs sbyor ba/ sbyor ba nges pa/ byed pa tshong pa/ bsdus rgyud rjes 'brangs byed rtsis kyi rgyu skar yang de mthun 'dzom pa'i nyin dge bar lha khang rnying pa brdal ba'i shul dang*/

de las phyi rol du bskyed dgos byung ba'i rgyu dang*/ rtag par bkra shis par 'gyur ba'i yan lag tu sa bdag lto 'phye'i gnas lugs thig gis legs par brtags nas/ klu chen rnams la gtor ma btang ba sogs sngon du 'gro bas dngos grub kyi sa blangs/ de'i tshe sa nang de nas gor ma dkar po nor bu'i dbyibs can khyim bya'i sgo nga 'dra ba'i yid du 'ong ba/ tshad ni ka pā la kha sbyar ba tsam yod pa gsum thon pa la gser gyi thig le 'od 'tsher ba can byung ngo*// de ltar dngos grub tu blangs pa'i sa des phyogs kun du khyab par dgram pa sogs cho ga'i dkyus nas bstan pa ltar bgyis/ de rjes nged rang dang rab bkram bla ma bstan 'dzin phun tshogs dang*/ dbu mdzad pa sogs bdun gyis kye rdo rje la brten pa'i sa chog rgyas pa dang*/ gzhan yang bstan bcos bai ḍūr dkar po las 'byung ba'i bcos sgrib dgos pa'i rigs dang gter gzhug pa dang*/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis lhun grub pa dang dpal ldan chos skyong pas bsgrubs pa'i nor bum dang klu bum gyi rigs mang du bcug bkra shis brtsegs pa sogs gsung rab sgrogs pa'i spyi bcos rnams sngon du 'gro ba bcas/ bzo dpon bkra shis la sogs pa ming bkra dang*/ dge mtshan legs pa'i gzhon nu rnams kyis rtsig rmang btings nas/ de dag so sor yang bkra shis lha dar dkar pos sna drangs pa'i legs 'bul dang dga' ston phun sum tshogs pas mnyes par bgyis pa'i las kyi 'go brtsams/ de'i phyi nyin rgya gar gyi a tsa ra rgan pa ā san ghir dang gzhon pa gho tan ghir zhes pa gnyis byung*/ dge bshes bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang nged rang gnyis la mjal dar so sor bzhag byung*/ rgan pa de skra dang sma ra bcas dkar pos song ba cig 'dug pa de la lo grangs ci tsam dris pas/ lo brgya dang sum cu yin zhes zer/ de tsam min las che yang kha dge legs po zhig byung*/

dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas te rmang rdo kha bsabs shing der smon lam legs par btab yod ces zer nas zhag gcig bsdad song*/ yang de rgyab gtsug lag khang che bzo zhig grub mtshams su'ang a tsa ra gnyis kyis mjal dar bcas byung*/ da lta'i mgon khang byas pa'i gyang ra de'i nang du zhag gcig gi nyal mal byas song*/ snga phyi gnyis ka'i a tsa ra de rnams la bza' btung bzang po bstabs nas/ brdzang bstar kha dar/ dngul srang*/ mgo snam gyi gos/ lham cha/ ja mar/ rtsam pa gang lcogs kyis dga' zhing tshim par byas so// de dag ni mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' lung gis bsgos pa rjes su sgrub pa'i bstan srung dbang po rnams kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa ni gor ma chag pa nyid do// gnyis pa ni/ 'di ltar gtsug lag khang dang pho brang zung 'brel gyi bzo dbyibs bkod pa la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag rags pa ni bshad ma thag pa ltar bzo gnas rig pa kun la mkhyen dpyod shel gyi me long ltar bkrag tu che ba mdun rin po che nyid nas bka' drin stsal mod/ slar yang bgyis ba 'di dag la sbyangs stobs dman pa min pas gzhan dring mi 'jog par mtho ris bi shwa karma'i dpal la sgrun pa'i blo gros can/ bzo dpon bkra shis can mngags pa gnang ba de dang dge bshes bsod nams rgyal mtshan rang gros bsdur gyi sgo nas brtson pa lhur blangs/ gzhan dngos rdzas mkho dgu'i gtong ba gang la gang dgos kyi dpag bsam yongs 'du lta bu'i phyag ring rkyong ba dang las kyi 'gan 'degs mi dman ri bo'i khur chen snying stobs kyi dpung rtser bkod pa'i do dam pa gong smos ltar dge bshes khu dbon zung gis gtsor mdzad/ las byed yongs kyi zhal ta ba dang las kyi tshag bsdu ba dang*/ mdun sa rin po che phan tshun du las dka'i skabs mtshams sleb min gyi snyan gsan stob pa dang dgos spyad 'dren pa'i tshegs len par bcas la blo gros rnam gsal 'tsho byed phun tshogs chos 'phel dang*/

gu ru tshe ring spun gyis bgyis/ gyang dpon dang las byed nang tshags bcas pa'i grogs ldan pa shing bzo tshul khrims bzang po sogs dang*/ 'gru dang rngad phu nas khang shing gcod 'dren 'go pa dge slong karma dpag bsam sogs dang*/ shing gzhogs pa bzo dpon bkra shis sogs bzo rig mkhas 'bring sum cu dang*/ sa rdo len bskyas 'jim las pa/ spen rgya 'ching ba sogs las byed dang 'u lag shin tu mang rab bcas dang*/ de dag gi rkyen sel du sku rim rgyun 'dzugs dang*/ gtor bzlog sogs 'phar ma'i rigs sgrub pa'i dge 'dun gyi 'du 'god mang po dang bcas pa ste/ de dag thams cad nas kyang las 'dir g.yo sgyu dang le lo med par rang las thog tu bab pa lta bu'i rtsol ba chen po'i sgo nas rtun pa lhur blang ngo*// nam zhig gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes gnyis la bab par/ gangs can ljongs pa'i rgyal bstan spyi'i rkyen sgo bye bas khri chen bla ma chen po nyid sngar nas snyung gzhi lji mor yod pa bcos su ma btub par zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i yi ge rnam par 'khrug pa'i gdangs su bsgyur/ des mchog dman 'gro ba'i khong pa'i sha mchog mya ngan gyi zhugs lces chur bzhu bar ma bzod chu rlabs kyi phreng ba 'dren byed dbang po'i sgor dbang med du lud pa'i dus skabs dman pa la ring zhig sbyor ba'i sngon las kyi byed po de yang glo bur du byung bar gyur to// de skad gtam gyi pho nya dang po dbang phyogs gong ma chen po'i snyan sgron du sim par brten/ mi ring bar de nyid kyi gcung por gyur pa'i rgyal ba'i myu gu chen po'i rnam thar 'dzin pa'i bla chen blo gros rgya mtsho'i sde nyid/ sde dge sa skyong gong ma'i gser khri mthon por shis pa'i rdzas mchog bye bas mdun bdar ba dang bcas te dbang bskur ba'i bka' lung las tham chen po bcas stsal bas/ chab 'bangs kyis mtshon skye 'gro rgya mtsho dbugs dbyung dge ba'i bkra shis dang po stsal to// de mtshams nas khri chen sa skyong chen po lcam dral 'di nyid nas gong ma'i dgongs rdzogs ched gtad du dmigs pa'i gtong phod chen po'i snying stobs zhum pa med pa'i bdag po'i rkyen sbyar te/

gang dang gang nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad dang*/ tshon gser du bcas pa'i gtong phod mi dman pa'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag dbye ba'i bka' drin stsal/ de mthun bkra shis ltem nas stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i sa skyong chen po nyid nas kyang yab sras zung gi zhabs stegs bskal par brtan phyir rgyal ba tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku brnyan dang*/ byams brtse'i bdag nyid sa skyong dbang mo tshe ring lags dus kyi chos nyid du thim pa'i dge rdzongs su ma pham byams chen gyi sku brnyan bcas bzheng ba'i bdag rkyen stsal ba'i bka' lung rin po che'i sgo dbye ba dang bcas pas sems kyi gzengs ci yang bstod par brten/ do dam las byed bcas pas g.yo sgyu med par gus spro mchog tu bskyed cing mngon par brtsams pas gtsug lag khang dang pho brang zung 'brel du bcas pa/ brtan brling bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa sprul pa'i lha gnas kyi khang bzang 'gran zlar chas pa 'di ko/ hor lugs kyi zla ba gnyis pa'am dbo zla'i nyer dgu nas brtsams pa'i tha skar zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi bar te/ zla ba drug dang zhag bcu'i nang du khang bzang dam pa spen bad sgo skas dkar khung tshun chad yongs su rdzogs pa legs par grub pa zhig byung bar/ blo dang ldan pa thams cad kyang zla zhag de tsam gyi bar la bya ba rgya che zhing bkod pa legs pa 'di bzhin grub pa ni sprul pa lta bu'o zhes ngo mtshar che ba'i bsngags brjod mgrin gcig tu mchid par gyur to// gnyis pa la/ nyer bsdogs bsags pa dang*/ rten gsum bskrun pa'o// dang po ni/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bstan pa'i snang byed mkhan po chen po skyabs gcig dam pa gang dang*/ sde dge sa skyong khri chen blo gros rgya mtsho pa mchod yon nyi zla zung 'brel lta bu nas/ kho bor bka' mchid stsal ba/ ldan chos sde'i gtsug lag khang legs par bzo grub nas/ der bris 'bur gyi rten bzheng rnams byed pa'i grabs shom skabs yin 'dug par/

rten rnams tshad ldan byon legs zhig ma byung na/ gzhan dag dpyas gdags pa'i gzhir gyur na mi rung*/ de bas na rten bzheng rnams kyi kha ta par khyod kyis 'gro dgos zhes bka' stsal gnang*/ spyir nged kyi yang mes bla ma sangs rgyas lha dbang zhes bya ba karma dbyangs can bzang po'am mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhabs kyi dngos slob tu gyur pas/ phyi nang gi gtsug lag spyi dang bye brag bzo rig pa'i lha ris mkhan la 'bri klung gser ldan ma'i 'gram gyi ljongs stod smad kun tu sman mkhyen gnyis pa lta bu'i mkhas mthongs shin tu che ba ma zad/ de'i phyag bris byas pa'i lha la rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga ma grub kyang ye shes pa bzhugs pa'i rtags mtshan bzang po kho na byung ba'i lo rgyus sngon nas da lta'i bar kun gyi thos pa 'dzin pa'i dpyid du mchis pa dang*/ kho bo cag kyang chung ngu nas tshegs dang rtsol ba chen por ma ltos par bslab sbyangs mthar phyin par gyur cig lhag par lha ris phal gyis gcig shes kun grol byas pa a pha'i cha tshad de lta bu min par/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ sdom 'byung*/ gshin rje'i gshed la sogs pa'i rgyud 'grel dag dang*/ de dag la brten pa'i bstan bcos sman lha don grub pa la sogs pa mkhas pas byas pa'i rgya bod kyi gzhung bzang rnams nas ji skad bshad pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa yum sras khro tshogs bcas pa'i tshad so sor 'byung ba rnams la 'dris lo bgyis pas/ skyon yon dpyod par gzhan dring 'jog ma dgos tsam yod na'ang*/ skyes bu'i 'dod thog tu gzhon pa'i gom pa bkod pa'i nges pa ma mchis pa ltar rang 'gros ji srid las kha ta'i thog tu 'gro ba zhig ni shin tu dka' na'ang*/ ci gsungs gang lcogs bgyid par khas 'che ba las zhu ham ma spobs par 'ongs so// lder bzo mkhan lha dpon tshe dbang rig 'dzin dpon g.yog brgyad dang*/ dbus phyogs kyi lha bzo gnyis/ ldebs ris mkhan lha ris pa mang tsam mchis pa las/

lha dpon karma'i lha dga' dang sde dgon ye shes blo gros kyis mtshon pa'i ri mo pa mi nyi shu bkrabs/ de mchan tshon mdangs pa nyer gcig tshon brgyabs pa dang tshon sbyor ba bcas nyer gsum/ gser 'dur ba dang gser shog mkhan sogs mang tsam bsags nas/ shing rtsi dang ngos dkar 'gyed pa la sogs pa'i nyer bsdogs rnams tshang bar bsgrigs so// gnyis pa ni/ 'dir skad rigs rnam pa bzhi las saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du aṅgi ra zhes bya/ gangs can pa'i brdar dbang thang dang rjes su mthun pa'i ming du chu pho sprel zhes bod pa/ de'i srog lus zung ga mthun pa lcags kyi khams/ klung rta shing dang*/ sme ba lnga ser dbus su zhugs pa'i khams bzhi ldan/ srog dbang ma bur gyur pa'i se zhig bkra shis kyi klung rtar bcibs pa'i gsar tshes kyi gnam lo/ dus 'khor ba'i lugs kyi dbyar rwa ba/ rgyu skar sa gas nya ba/ nyin byed glang gi khyim du rtsen pas dbang gi phrin las kyi dpal bskyed pa/ rten cing 'brel pa 'byung ba reg pa can/ hor lugs dang tshe'i rig byed pa mthun pa'i zla ba bzhi pa/ dbyig 'dzin ma'i khams kyi rang bzhin can gyi lug dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa/ dus 'khor ba'i dbyangs ār/ gsal byed ṭār/ 'byung ba me/ 'dod yon ro'o// thal ba'i dbang po'i lugs kyi dbyangs ū/ gsal byed dzha/ 'byung ba me/ 'dod yon gzugs so// gnyis ka mthun par dar gud lang tsho/ nyi ma rta/ spar kha kham/ sme ba gnyis nag res gza' zla ba/ rgyu skar khrums smad/ 'phrod chen

25 phyi char glang po/ 'byung ba'i 'phrod bdud rtsi'i sbyor ba 'dzom pa'i nyin gtso bo thub chen dang*/ tshe dpag med dang*/ sangs rgyas byams pa gsum gyi sku'i srog shing 'dzugs pa dang*/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i 'phel gdung sogs dang*/ chos sku'i ring bsrel bcing ba sogs kyi 'go brtsams/ yang hor zla lnga pa'i lcags sbrel gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa/ res gza' lha'i bla ma dang rgyu skar lha mo sa ga phrad pa'i nyin/ ldebs bris kyi thig gi cha dbye ba bcas gtso bo thub pa bdud 'dul dang chos 'chad kyi rnam pa can gnyis 'dri ba'i 'go tshugs/ de'ang bris 'bur gyi gtso bo 'di rnams tshad ji lta bus gtan la phab pa yin snyam na/ dper mtshon tsam gleng ba la/ 'jal byed dang gzhal bya gnyis las/ dang po ni nas zhes pa gnyis la ni rkang pa dang*/ de bzhi la cha phran nam sor mo'am cha chung zhes bya/ de 'dra phyed dang bcu gsum mam bcu gnyis skabs su gang bab kyis gdong ngam zhal lam thal mo'am mtho zhes bya ste/ 'dis ni sku gzugs che phra thams cad tshad kyis gtan la 'bebs par byed do// gnyis pa ni/ rje btsun ma pham pas/ sku ni n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab/ ces gsungs pas de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i sku chu zheng mi mnyam pa med pa nyid nges par dgos shing de la'ang dpyad par bya ba 'di ltar snang ste/ phyis kyi mkhas pa kha cig dus 'khor dang krī yā sogs nas bshad pa'i sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa ni 'bur gyi dbang du byas pa'o// sdom 'byung nas bshad pa'i sor mo brgya nyi shu pa ni bris kyi dbang du byas pa yin no zhes bzhed do// de la brten nas deng gi dus kyi dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi lha bris pa phal che ba dag byang chub sems dpa'i thig dpe re bslabs nas/ des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nas brtsams te zhi ba'i rigs su gtogs pa pho mo phal che ba dag la nad brgya sman gcig ltar nag 'gros su byed pa mthong ste/

de rnams ni ma brtags par ri bong cal rgyug gi rjes su 'brang ba kho nar sems so// ci'i phyir na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rgyan can dang rgyan med kyi khyad par cung zad min pa bris 'bur khyad med du sor mo brgya nyer lnga par byas pas khyab pa ni/ rgyud dang mkhas pa'i bstan bcos mang po nas mgrin gcig tu mthun par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gang du gsungs na/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi ye shes le'u las/ rgyal ba'i bdag po gtsug tor nas ni mdzod spu'i dbus su phyed dang bcas pa nyi ma'i sor du 'gyur// de nas mgrin pa'i chu skyes de bzhin snying ga dang ni de nas lte gsang chu skyes de bzhin no// zhabs kyi 'og dang rje ngar brla dang dpyi dang ma nu de nyid de nyid rig byed rnams kyis te// brang phyed phyed bcas nyi mas rang dpung dpung lag rnams ni mkha' mig rgyal po nyi ma'i tshad kyis so// nyi shu 'ga' zhig lhag pa'i brgya phrag gang zhig dus dang dgu yis mi rnams kyi ni 'jig rten tshad// rig byed phyed dang bcas pa'i bzhi dang chu gter chu gter phyed dang bcas pa'i rig byed rig byed kyis// gtsug tor mgo bo 'og tu 'gyur te rgyal ba'i bdag po'i dpal ldan dpral ba dag dang shangs dang ni// shangs kyi 'og tu kos ko'i mtha' dang de nas mgrin pa dag ste mgrin pa'i rtsa ba'i chu skyes dbus// de nas snying ga lte ba gsang bar mi yi bdag po phyed bcas nyi ma rnams kyi rim par 'gyur// gsang ba'i chu skyes lte ba'i rtsa bar rdo rje dag kyang thub pa yis ni steng gi gtsug tor nyid// ces de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum pa'i mtho bcu par gsungs shing*/ krī yā sa muts+tsha'i dkyil chog gi sa dpyad drug pa las/ de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyi sku'i ring bar dpung pa gnyis ngos su rab tu brkyang ba ste zheng du yang ngo*// tshad rnams ci zhe na/

rang gi sor gyi sor phyed dang bcu gnyis ni mtho'o// de nyid bcu la ni sor nyi shu rtsa lngas lhag pa'i brgya'o zhes so// sdom 'byung gi rgyud kyi 'grel pa pad+ma can zhes pa/ rat+na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa las kyang*/ zhal gyi'ang bcu gnyis cha dang cha chung dang sor dang sor mo zhes pa don gcig ste/ de thams cad cha chung gi rnam par dbye ba shes par bya'o// bcom ldan 'das kyis ni sangs rgyas kyi gzugs nyid la phyed dang bcas pa'i cha chung bcu gnyis pa'i zhal bya'o zhes dang*/ de'ang bcom ldan 'das kyi phyed dang bcas pa'i sor mo bzhis 'gyur te phyed dang bcas pa'i cha chung bcu gnyis kyi zhal nyid las so zhes sangs rgyas kyi zhal tshad sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum par bshad pa'i phyir yang de las 'od med do// yang de nyid du/ bcu gnyis cha zhes pa ni sangs rgyas las gzhan thams cad thun mong ba nyid du gsungs pa'o zhes so// de bzhin du sman bla don grub pas mdzad pa dang sprul sku 'phrang kha bas mdzad pa'i cha tshad kyi yi ge las kyang bris 'bur khyad par med pa mchog gi sprul sku'i tshad la sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa bshad pa'i phyir ro// de bas na 'dir yang bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi sku'i rigs gyur rnams la ni sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum pa'i tshad kyis thal mo bcu par byas so// thig chen gnyis pa de las gzhan pa byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa zhi ba thun mong ba 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha byad can rnams ni/ sdom 'byung 'grel par/ mtshams dang mtshams la so sor cha chung gnyis gnyis chad par 'gyur te/ de na byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa'i lha rnams la sku'i stod smad dag gi cha chung phyed dang bcas pa gnyis gnyis phri ba las/ cha chung nyi shus lhag pa brgya'i tshad kyi skur 'gyur ro zhes dgongs pa'o zhes dang*/ bslab btus sogs las bshad ltar sor mo nyi shus lhag pa'i brgya'i tshad dang*/ thig chen gsum pa/

rgyal yum yid 'phrog pa'i gzugs can rnams ni/ sdom pa 'byung bar/ yid du 'ong ba'i rang gzugs ni// thal mo dgu pa mngon par 'dri// zhes pa ltar sor brgyad kyis lhag pa'i brgya dang*/ thig chen bzhi pa/ sbom thung gtum drag can rnams ni/ de nyid las/ khro bo khro mo dbang phyug ma// bran pho bran mo ci bgyi ma// drag cing 'jigs pa'i gzugs rnams ni// thal mo brgyad pa rnam par 'dri// zhes sor mo go drug pa'i tshad dang*/ thig chen lnga pa/ mi'u thung ltar khros pa rnams ni/ krī yā sa muts+tshar/ rā hu la dang mi'u thung dang tshogs kyi bdag po rnams ni mtho lnga pa bya'o zhes lag tu blang ba'i rim par thod dpangs sogs lhag ma btang bas sor mo bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa dang*/ thig chen drug pa mi rnams kyi tshad ni/ dri med 'od du/ de nyid sems can rnams kyi khru bzhi ste/ mi rnams kyi sor dgu bcu rtsa drug go /steng dang 'og tu ni sor brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ste/ de ltar mi rnams mtshan dang mi ldan pa'o zhes pa ste/ thig khong 'dir nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi tshad bstan pa ste/ de ltar na de dag so so'i tshad rnams kyi lag tu blang ba'i rim pa rnams las skabs su gang babs rnams la dpyod pa'i khul bgyis pa lags/ hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bzhir nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor 'dzom par mgon khang gi ldebs ris 'dri ba'i 'go tshugs/ zla ba de'i tshes bcu bzhi'i gza' skar bdud rtsi'i mthun sbyor yod pa'i nyin par/ bris 'bur gyi gtso chen rnams kyi spyan dbye ba dang*/ tshes nyi shu bkra shis tshangs dbyug thogs pa'i 'grub sbyor 'dzom par/ lam 'bras khang dang gtsang khang gi logs bris brtsams/ hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu bzhi mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshes khyad par can la sngar gyi mgon po lha brgyad rnying pa'i sku brnyan rnams mgon khang gsar par gdan 'dren rgyu'i snga nyin bdag dang dge slong nyung shas kyis bskang gso byas/

de'i mtshan mor mgon khang gsar pa'i sgo 'byed gcod lan mang byas shing 'ur sgra dang tsheg sgra chen po byung bas de nas brtsams te lha bzo ba rnams mgon khang sgo der nyal mi phod pa'i dngangs skrag byung*/ phyi nyin nang sngar phyogs kun char sprin lang ling 'khrigs pa las dgung char zim bu babs pas sa gzhi thams cad du chag chag gdab/ nyi ma shar tsam nas gur mgon lha brgyad/ gdong bzhi dpal mgon 'khor bcas kyi sku brnyan rnams mchod pa'i yo byad du ma dang bcas pas spyan 'dren pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' nas kha dog lnga pa'i 'ja' tshon shar ba kun gyis mthong ba sogs dge mtshan bzang po byung*/ de ltar spyan drangs pa'i bstan srung dbang po'i sku brnyan rnying pa'i gtso bo mi tshad tsam dang*/ 'khor rnams de'i phyed tshad tsam yod pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar bar bzhugs pa rnams/ mkhan chen thams cad gzigs pa'i bkas gnang ltar/ rten bzheng gsar pa so so'i sku khog tu nang gzhug gi tshul du gos dar mang pos dril nas bzhugs su gsol ba dang chabs cig nang rten 'og tu bsnyad par 'gyur ba ltar phul/ de'i phyi nas gtso bo phal thog gcig gi sku tshad dang*/ gzhan rnams phyed tshad tsam byas nas bzheng ba'i 'go brtsams/ hor zla dgu pa'i nyer gsum bkra shis kyi nyi ma shar ba la rten bzhengs thams cad kyi bgyi ba mthar son par byas pas/ de dag gi skabs su las byed pa yon sbyor bcas la nye zho ci yang ma byung ba dang*/ ji snyed brtsams pa'i bris 'bur thams cad la kho bos bslab bcos kha bkod gang lcogs bgyis pas bzo bo rnams kyang bsgo ba rnar gzon du ma song bar brtun pa bskyed song bas phyogs thams cad nas legs rab cig byung 'dug pa kun gyi 'dren byed dbang po'i dga' ston du mngon pa 'di dag lags so// smras pa/ rkang pa dang po dang gnyis pa yod pa'i zung ldan/ mngon gyur mngon pa min pa'i bdag nyid can// mngon 'dod 'dzad med dpal gyis tshim par bstabs// de las 'khon bral sa yi thig le zhig

/rang dbang bde bar nod pa ga la bar// ma hā bho ṭa'i yul 'dir bkra shis mtshan// rdzogs par blta phyir gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha'i// khang bzangs blta na sdug pa'i phung po de// mngon 'dod kyis myos 'di na chags sam snyam// 'byor pa rgya che ba/ rin chen gdung ka bye bas mdzes bteg pa// mtho brling brtsegs pa'i ba gam ngos rtse las// dril bu g.yer kha 'thab pa'i dbyangs 'jo zhing*// rin chen tog gis srid pa'i mun pa phrogs// bsdus dang ma bsdus bsres pa'i gzugs can/ bsod nams mchod sbyin brgya pa'i mdzub rtse yis// ye shes snang ba dag pa'i shel gyi gzhir// rnam bkra mtshan bzang ri dwags bkrag po ches// nyer sdud dam pa'i gzugs brnyan bye bas gtams// ston dngos po'i dpe rgyan/ dus mkha' dbyings dag par rgyu skar phreng*// grangs med bstar ba 'dren byed dpyid gyur bzhin// mthong don rnam dkar snying pos cher lci ba// mchog gi sprul gzugs ltad mor mi dgyes su// zhes gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i gleng ba kun dga'i 'dzum zer 'dzag pa'i zla gzhon las ji ltar bskrun pa'i tshul gyi sarga ste gnyis pa'o// //spyi don gsum pa bskrun pa'i rten gyi bzhugs byang smos pa la/ bris sku dang*/ 'bur sku gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge'i bstan pa 'dir ston pa'i sku brnyan bris 'bur gnyis las bris sku snga bar byung ba'i tshul yang*/ grong khyer rgyal po'i khab kyi rgyal po gzugs can snying po dang*/ sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal po u dra yā ṇa gnyis yul gyis bskal pas phan tshun mthong ma myong ba'i mdza' bor gyur te skyes bsring res yod par/ nam zhig u dra yā ṇas nor bu'i go khrab rin thang gzhal du med pa zhig bskur ba'i lan du/ ston pa'i sku brnyan bskur ba legs pa mngon te/

ri mo par ston pa'i sku brnyan 'drir bcug kyang sku lta bas chog mi shes par g.yeng bas sku tshad 'dri ma shes par/ ston pa chu 'gram du bzhugs pa'i snang brnyan chur shar ba dper byas nas/ bris pa la chu lon mar grags pa de nyid rin po che'i dong bur bcug par gos bzang gis bklubs te glang po che'i rgyab tu bkal nas bskur ba/ rgyal pos sku gzugs de zhal phye ste mjal bas rten cing 'brel ba 'byung ba'i don rtogs nas bden pa mthong ba dang*/ de rjes siṅga la'i rgyal po'i bu mo mu tig 'khri shing gis ston pa la dad pas skyes phul ba'i lan du/ ras kyi gzhi la ston pa'i sku'i 'od zer bkye ste/ de'i steng rig byed pas ri mos mnan pa'i thang sku de spring yig dang bcas te bskur ba mthong ba'i 'phral la bu mos bden pa mthong ba dang*/ de rjes shig na ston pas yum gyi don du lha gnas su gshegs pa'i tshe/ grong khyer gsal ldan gyi rgyal pos mchod gnas su bcom ldan 'das kyi sku bzheng bar 'dod pa na/ maung gal gyi bu'i rdzu 'phrul la brten te bzo bos lha yul du phyin nas sku'i bzhugs tshul yid la nges par byas nas/ tsan+dan go shīr+ṣa las byas pa'i sku brnyan bzhengs pa de ston pa dngos dang 'dra bar grags pa nyid 'bur sku'i thog ma yin no zhes 'byung*/ des na 'dir yang bris skus thog drangs te smos pa la/ gtsug lag khang la ka ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod par zhing khams nyi shu rtsa gnyis bri khyams mchis pa'i g.yas logs kyi gtso bo kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyis bdud sde 'dul ba'i dus su phyag sa non dang mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can la nyan thos mchog zung dang mdun du yab yum sras dang rim gro par bcas dang*/ g.yon du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor dus kyi sku'i rnam pa chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can la tshangs pa brgya byin gnyis dang nyan thos mchog rnams kyis bskor ba/
