g.yas logs mtha' sgo 'gram du rdo rje gur mgon la/ steng phyogs su bla ma brgyud pa yi dam kha shas/ g.yas su zhing skyong bram ze'i gzugs can/ g.yon du lha mo 'dod khams dbang mo/ mtha' skor du las mgon gyi rigs dang dur khrod yab yum/ dmag zor rgyal mo/ zangs gri can/ dkar mo bdud rgyal/ gnod sbyin beg tser bcas pas bskor ba/ g.yon logs mtha'i sgo 'gram du rgyal chen ngal bsos po pho brang 'khor sa bcas pa/ steng phyogs su bla ma brgyud pa/ mtha' skor du gnod sbyin rta bdag brgyad kyis bskor ba/ de'i mdun du bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po zhing gshegs pa bde ldan zhing gi bkod pa'i nang du yod pa dang*/ da ltar bzhugs pa'i mchod yon rin po che 'khor tshogs su bcas pa rin po che'i khang bzang gi nang na rgya bod yul gru'i skye 'gros nye bar btud pa'i rnam pa can du byas pa/ de min pa'i zhing khams gzhan bco brgyad po thams cad la 'phags pa'i yul gyi snyan dngags smra ba kun gyi gtsug tor lta bu chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang po dang de'i sras zla ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing le'u brgya dang brgyad kyis bstan pa rnams ri mo'i lam du bkod pas khyab par bkram/ de dag gi steng phyogs kyi nam mkhar so thar dang byang sems sdom brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam lha tshogs 'ga' zhig gtsang khang gi nang logs g.yas kyi gtso bo sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa dang g.yon gyi gtso bo kun rig rnam par snang mdzad la/ kun rig rtsa lha so gnyis bcas la sangs rgyas stong dang ltung bshags sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba/ rgya mthongs la byang chub ltung ba bshags pa'i sangs rgyas rnams bzhugs so// mgon khang du kye rdo rje lha dgu/ 'jigs byed phyogs skyong bcas/ las kyi gshin rje lha bcu gsum/ mgon po che chung 'khor bcas dang mgron lha nyung shas bcas bris/

rgya mthongs kyi gtso bo rdo rje 'chang*/ g.yon du sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ kun dga' bzang po gsum la lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pas bskor ba dang*/ sangs rgyas sman bla lta na sdug gi bkod pa bcas dang*/ g.yas su ston pa thub dbang dang sangs rgyas byams pa gnyis la gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med bde ldan zhing gi bkod pa can/ lam 'bras lha khang ka ba bzhi zug par gtso bo rdo rje 'chang la lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa zhing khams ma'i bkod pa dang*/ g.yas su sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta dang 'gro mgon 'phags pa gnyis la paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam thar rgyas pa skal bzang legs lam zhes bya ba rin spungs sa spyod dbang pos mdzad pa ltar dang*/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la de'i rnam thar gyis bskor ba/ g.yon du 'phags mchog klu sgrub dang*/ stobs kyi mgon po bir+wa pa gnyis la grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba/ mkhan po chen po dpal ldan chos skyong la de'i rnam thar mdor bsdus kyis bskor ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge gtso 'khor lnga la rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i bkod pas bskor ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong can la spyan ras gzigs 'jigs pa brgyad skyob dang po ta la'i zhing bkod kyis bskor ba/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can la sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyis bskor ba/ tshe dpag med la 'dod lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba rnams bzhugs so// de dag gi gseb tshags rnams su sngar gyi lha khang rnyings par yod pa'i sku brnyan gong du ma thus pa rnams dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi sgo khang du rgyal chen bzhi sku tshad shin tu che ba dang*/ mngon pa mdzod las 'byung ba'i 'jig rten chags tshul dang*/ 'dul ba lung nas bshad pa'i srid pa'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa'i gzugs kyi bkod pa byas pa rnams so// de dag gi steng phyogs sogs su khro bo bcu dang 'dod lha nyung shas/

tshe ring ljongs kyi gzugs ris dang*/ yul ris gzhi bdag gnyan po 'ga' re sogs ci mdzes su bkod do// gnyis pa 'bur sku la bzhugs byang smos pa dang*/ nang rten bzhugs grangs smos pa'o// dang po ni/ rten gyi gtso bo gtsang khang dbus su thub dbang bdud 'dul gyi rnam pa can bzhugs khri'i dpangs mi brtsi bar pad+ma nas gtsug tor bar mtho bco lnga yod pa seng khri rgyan drug gis mdzes pa/ g.yas g.yon du nyan thos mchog zung bzhengs pa/ g.yas su bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po sa skyong bsod nams mgon po yab sras zhabs brtan gyi ched du/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa dang*/ g.yon du sa 'dzin dbang mo tshe ring lags dus kyi chos nyid du thim pa'i gshegs rdzong du 'byon gyur gyi sangs rgyas ma pham pa'i sku brnyan te/ gnyis ka'ang pad+ma nas gtsug tor gyi bar mtho bcu gsum yod pa bzhugs khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa'o// lho dang nub kyi logs gnyis su brag ri'i nang na bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi dang dharma tā/ ha shang rnams mda' gang re'i sku tshad bzhugs so// mgon khang du gtso bo rdo rje gur mgon gyi sku/ de'i g.yas g.yon rnams nas phyag na rdo rje dang*/ zhing skyong bram ze'i gzugs can/ ral gcig ma/ gnod sbyin yab yum/ pu tra ming sring gsum/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu rnams bzhugs so// lam 'bras khang du gtso bo sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang dang*/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ dpal ldan chos skyong rnams kyi sku tshad mtho drug re/ gzhan rnams mtho gnyis kyi tshad re yod pa'i lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan gyi bar yongs rdzogs dang*/ gzhan yang btsong kha pa/ karma pa/ nam mkha' legs pa/ kho bo'i gzugs brnyan bzos pa rnams bzhugs so// gnyis pa ni/

rten gyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge'i sku brnyan mthong ba don yod ces bya ba 'di nyid kyi nang zhugs su/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi 'phel gdung gcig sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i 'phel gdung gnyis/ rdo rje 'chang gi gser sku/ thub dbang gser sku/ dam rdzas las grub pa'i bir+wa pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i dbu zhwa/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i na bza'/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi na bza'/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i pur tshwa dang pur ras/ brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang gi na bza'/ sa ngor gyi bla ma gong ma phal cher gyi na bza' dang gdung tshwa'i rigs/ dam pa sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung*/ drung nam mkha' legs pa'i dbu thod/ rus rgyan/ dge slong ma dpal mo'i na bza'/ zhabs drung kun dga' legs pa'i gdung tshwa/ thar rtse nam mkha' rin chen pa'i gdung rus/ byams pa bsod nams bzang po'i gdung tshwa/ mkhan po bkra shis lhun grub pa'i na bza'/ mkhan chen tshul khrims lhun grub pa'i gdung rus na bza'/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub pa'i sku chings/ sa skya pa bsod nams dbang phyug gi ḍā ma ru'i tshal bu/ gong ma kun dga' bkra shis pa'i phyag phreng*/ gong ma kun dga' bsod nams rin chen pa'i na bza'/ kun mkhyen bkra shis dbang phyug pa'i dbu zhwa/ dbu lo/ bla ma sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i gdung rus/ na bza'/ mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa'i gdung rus/ rdo rje 'chang bkra shis bzang po'i gdung rus/ grub chen thang stong rgyal pos bsgrubs pa'i tshe ril/ bla ma phyi ma rnams kyis bsgrubs pa'i tshe ril/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas bsgrubs pa'i 'jam dbyangs yab yum gyi ril bu/ gtsang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas bsgrubs pa'i dam rdzas/ ma ṇi ril bu/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes dbang po'i na bza'/ sa skya'i dam rdzas brgya do dang stong do mang po/ sil bu stong phrag ngor pa'i dam rdzas brgya do/

sil bu mang po/ dpal sa skya'i rten 'dam dpe bral mar grags pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis pa nas 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i phyag tu brgyud de byung ba/ sde dge sa skyong rim par byon pa rnams kyi phyag tu 'byor pa'i sa skya'i rten 'dam dang*/ byin rlabs rten khyad 'phags bzhugs pa rnams mkhas btsun bkra shis dbang phyug pas phyogs gcig tu bsags pa'i rten 'dam 'di'i nang du bzhugs grangs ni/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi tshems/ paṇa chen ga ya dhā ras bsgrubs pa'i bum chu'i rgyun/ sa chen kun snying gi gdung rus/ bsod nams rtse mo'i sku chings/ rje btsun grags pa'i sku ber/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i dbu lo/ rje btsun gong ma'i gar gos/ sa lo'i sku ber dang pur ras/ bse 'bag rgya gar nas phebs dus kyi zhal khebs/ bdag chen ngag pa'i dbu thod/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams pa'i dbu skra/ glo bo mkhan chen gdung rus dang pur ras/ rtse gdong khri chen pa'i dbu skra/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi ljags thun/ tshar chen gyi rten gtor/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku khrus gdung thal ril bu/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i sku chings dang dbu zhwa mgul sgrog thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang pa'i dbu skra dang na bza'/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ 'jam dbyangs dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhan po lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rin po che shes bya bzang po/ mkhan po tshul khrims dpal bzang*/ dbu mdzad kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhas grub bkra shis dpal ldan/ thub bstan mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab ngag dbang lhun grub/ zhwa lu mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub rnams kyi gdung rus 'khrul med dang*/ rten byin rlabs can mang po'i zhal phyis dang zhal rdul dang*/

ngor pa'i rten 'dus sogs du ma gcig tu bsdus pa khungs ldan 'khrul bral kho na bzhugs pa rnams so// gzhan yang slob dpon pad+mas mi 'gyur rdo rjer gnang ba'i myang grol sha rī ram/ skye bdun myang grol ril bu/ gter gyi shog ser rigs/ mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gnam gter nas spyan drangs pa'i myang grol/ skye bdun ril bu/ ma ṇi ril bu mang po/ dpal yul byang chub gling pa'i rten 'dus dang*/ bdud rtsi chos sman rtags thon du bsgrubs pa'i rigs mang po/ karma pa dpa' bo gtsug lag pa'i dbu lo/ zhwa dmar ba'i gdung dkris/ chos kyi don grub na bza'/ karma'i ril nag mang po/ 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gdung tshwa/ 'brug ril 'ja' zug ma/ rtag lung rtse'i gdung rus/ 'bri gung pa'i sāts+tsha dang gdung tshwa'i rigs te/ de lta bu'i rten 'dus khyad par 'phags pa rnams las btab pa'i sku brnyan dang sāts+tsha'i rigs bzhi brgya nyer brgyad tsam/ de thams cad kyang gser dngul gyis mdzes par byas pa rnams so// chos sku'i ring bsrel du grags pa la/ da ltar sde dges par du bkod pa'i gzungs par rgyas pa'i nang ltar gyi rgyud sde gong 'og so so'i dbang bskur rjes gnang khrid bshad rnams kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan gzungs sde tshan yongs rdzogs tshar bcu gsum/ rgyud sde gong 'og tu gsungs so cog gi lha sngags gzungs sngags sogs yongs rdzogs tshar bcu gsum/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gtsug tor dri med/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ rten 'brel snying po/ byang chub rgyan 'bum ste gzungs chen sde lnga po tshar bco brgyad/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa sogs mdo gzungs kyi sde tshan tshar bco brgyad/ mdo rgya cher rol pa po ti gcig sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa po ti bcu gnyis/ brgyad stong pa po ti gcig bcas dang*/ rdo rje gur mgon lcam dral las mgon gdong bzhi pa sogs gsar rnying rgyud sde so so'i chos skyong ba rnams kyi sngags kyi sde tshan tshar bcu bdun/

rnam thos sras sogs gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyi gzungs sngags sde tshan tshar bcu bdun/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis bkra shis/ khyim bdag des par gsungs pa sogs bkra shis smon lam gyi sde tshan tshar bcu bdun re/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i 'dod gsol tshar bcu bdun/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa dang bkra shis lhun grub pa'i zhal snga nas yun ring du bsgrubs pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo gsar rnying tshar brgyad/ mgon dkar 'khor lo dang bum gter yun ring du bsgrubs pa gnyis te gzungs dang glegs bam byin rlabs rten gyi sku rnams kyang gos dar ser po'i na bza' bcas te bzhugs su gsol lo// gzhan yang gnod sbyin bang mdzod du rin po che'i rdog po gser dang*/ dngul dang mu tig dang*/ shel dang*/ mu men dang*/ sbur len shel dang*/ ke ke ru dang pad+ma rā ga dang mchong dang*/ byi ru dang*/ gzi dang*/ g.yu dung la sogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang rin po che sna tshogs bsdus pa'i phye ma/ tsan+dan dkar dmar gyi sdong po/ bum pa'i nang rdzas nyer lnga sogs bzang sman sna tshogs/ spos sna tshogs/ rgya ja'i rigs/ dkar gsum mngar gsum dang*/ shing thog gi rigs/ 'bras gro la sogs pa 'bru'i rigs/ gos dar gyi rigs/ rgya gar rdo rje'i gdan gyis mtshon pa'i gnas chen rnams kyi sa rdo'i rigs te/ de dag kyang ras kyi khug mar blugs te brtan par bcug go /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa dang sangs rgyas byams pa'i sku chen po gnyis ka la/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gdung yungs 'bru tsam re re/ gong du smos pa'i gzungs rgyas pa yongs rdzogs tshar brgyad brgyad dang*/ gzungs chen sde lnga tshar dgu re/ sangs rgyas mtshan gzungs rnams tshar sum cu rtsa gcig re/ gdung tsha dang rten 'dus kyi lha sku mi 'dra ba du ma khyon bzhi brgya nyer drug brgyad stong pa bi warta can dang*/ brgyad stong mdo rkyang tshar gsum/

nyi khri/ bskal bzang*/ rgya che rol pa rnams tshar re/ mngon rtogs rgyan dang kun du dgos pa'i gzhung bdun gyi po ti/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bka' 'bum po ti gcig rnams gser dngul gyis bris pa/ grub thob nam mkha' legs pa'i dbu thod kyi tshal bu/ rus rgyan/ bla ma gong ma mang pos bsgrubs pa'i dam rdzas ril bu la sogs pa dang*/ rin po che dang 'bru rigs rnams sngar bzhin no// nyan thos mchog gnyis la 'phel gdung re dang bcas te gzhan gnas brtan bcu drug rgyal chen bzhi/ dharma tā ha shang bcas pa'i re re la'ang gong du smos pa'i sku brnyan dang gzungs yongs rdzogs tshar grangs ci 'gro bgyis/ khyad par gur gyi mgon po'i sku 'dir sngar gyi sku rnying pa khyad 'phags nang rten bzhugs pa bcas dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung dang kye rdor dang gur mgon gyi gser skus thog drangs pa'i nang rten gyi sku brnyan mang po dang*/ gzungs yongs rdzogs tshar brgyad tsam dang*/ khyad par chos skyong rnams kyi gzungs yongs rdzogs tshar sum cus mtshon gzhan thams cad gong dang 'dra'o// zhing skyong bram ze'i gzugs can dang*/ e ka dza ṭī/ dpal ldan lha mo/ las mgon pho mo lnga/ dur khrod yab yum rnams kyang sku rnying pa nang rten du bzhugs pa'i khar gzungs dang byin rlabs rten gang 'gro dang*/ khyad par dpal mgon/ lha mo/ dur khrod bdag po/ rnam thos sras rnams la sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung re bzhugs so// lam 'bras khang na bzhugs pa'i gtso bo rdo rje 'chang dang*/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan chos skyong rnams kyi sku brnyan la de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung 'khrul med re dang*/ byin rlabs rten 'dus kyi sku mang po/ gzungs rgyas pa gsum nas lnga bar gang chud byas/ lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pas mtshon gzhan thams cad la byin rlabs rten 'dus kyi sku ci mang dang*/

gzungs rgyas pa tshar re dang 'bring bsdus gang 'tsham bzhugs su gsol ba yin no// nang gzungs 'di dag so sor bzhugs pa'i rnam grangs dang*/ rten 'dam tha dad du 'phags bod mkhas grub rnams kyi ring bsrel byin rlabs rten 'dus tshul rgyas par spros na brjod bya shin tu mang ba mchis mod/ 'dir yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas shin tu nyung ngu'i ngag gis gleng ba re zhig de tsam mo// mdor na rten bzhengs 'di rnams kyi nang zhugs kho na la bsams kyang 'jig rten khams su bde legs 'dzad pa med par 'byung ba'i gzhi chen po nyid du gyur pa ni nges pa nyid do// smras pa/

ldan pa'i gzugs can/ gang zhig dwang 'dod zhing sa rab gshin par// rnam dkar sa bon rma med kyis sbrum pas// bsod nams tshogs kyi sdong bu bskyed bsrings rtser// gzugs sku'i snyem ma smin byed cho ga de// yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa/ gnyis med dus 'khor bde mchog sdom 'byung sogs// rgyud 'grel dri med kyis bstan drang thig gi /khong nas legs par 'khrungs pa'i bde gshegs sku// 'jig rten mchod sdong dam pa bskrun pa'i mthu// rgyal nges pa phul byung*/ ba de sras slob mar bcas kun gyi// snang brnyan lam gsum 'gro ba'i legs byas zhing*// bskrun 'dir stong gsum ma lus kañca nas// yongs su bkang pas brgya stong char mi phod// ldan pa'i gzugs can/ 'phags yul gangs can yul dang yul gru'i mkhar// dran dbang smra ba'i nyi ma gang shar ba// de de'i chos gzugs sku yi ring bsrel gyis// gtams phyir 'dzam gling lte ba 'di yin snyam// nges pa'i dpe/ gzugs sku bris 'bur bgrang du med pa'i mtshar// nyi ma'i gnyen gyis phyogs bcu'i zhing kun du// 'khor tshogs dbus su rang 'dra lham me bar// sprul pa de las mtshungs dpe srid na dkon// zhes gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i gleng ba kun dga'i 'dzum zer 'dzag pa'i zla gzhon las bskrun pa rten gyi bzhugs byang smos pa'i sarga ste gsum pa'o// //spyi don bzhi pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba la/ bzo bo mnyes par bgyis pa dang*/ rab gnas ji ltar bgyis pa'o// dang po ni/ spyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa 'dir/ byang chub kyi spyad pa spyod pas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ rang gzhan gyi dbul ba'i duḥkha bsal bar bya ba'i phyir sbyin pa'i bsngags brjod kyi gtam la spro ba mdzad de/ zung gi mdor/

gang dag nga yi bstan pa la// sbyin pa skra tsam byin pa ni// bskal pa stong phrag brgyad cu ru// longs spyod che zhing nor yang mang*// zhes so// khyad par rten gsum bzhengs pa'i bzo bo mnyes dgos pa ni/ bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod par/ de bas na bzo 'ba' zhig mi rnams kyi nyams su dben pa yin te/ bzo bo ni rigs dma' bar skyes na'ang rgyal po rnams dang*/ bram ze dang*/ khyim bdag rnams kyis gdon mi za bar bkur ro// sna tshogs las pa lha rnams dang*// mi rnams kyis kyang legs par bkur// de bzhin ma rabs bzo yi phyir// mi dang lha rnams kyis kyang bkur// zhes bshad pas bzo byed pa ni thams cad kyis mchod kyin bkur ba dang mgu bar bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa nyid do// de bzhin du/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las kyang*/ bzo bo ma mnyes pa'i lha la ni ye shes pa mi 'jug ste/ rab gnas kyi thog mar bzo bo mnyes par bya'o zhes dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyud las/ bris sku tshad dang ldan pa yongs su zin pa dang 'dri mkhan kho rang ji ltar 'dod pa'i yon phab pa ltar sbyin par bya'o zhes gsungs pa dang rjes su mthun par/ 'di ltar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i las byed pa rnams la khri chen sa skyong bla ma chen po nyid nas bka' stsal gyi bkod pa ji ltar phebs pa rjes su sgrub pa'i mkhyen sgo rnam par yangs pa par dpon don grub nas gang ci'i gtong phod mi dman pa'i dpal 'byor nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye ba las/ dar ras kyi rigs kha dog sna tshogs/ ma hāñci dang*/ gos chen gyi rigs/ ther phrug gi rigs/ ja mar dang*/ gro nas dang*/ gser dngul dang*/ khro zangs dang*/ rta mdzo dang*/ 'bri g.yag gi sde tshan mang po sogs smar zong gi dngos po gya nom pa rim par stsal ba gzhir byas/ de'i steng du mkhan po rin po che nas kyang snga phyir gro nas bsdoms pa khal drug cu/

gser zho bcu gnyis/ tshon kha dog sna tshogs/ mdzo g.yag la sogs pa'i kha 'debs ltos che ba stsal ba dang*/ bkra shis ltem gyi sa skyong chen po nas ja ko tse 'khor drug gcig gzhung ja 'khor drug bzhi/ mar rgya sum brgya dang gsum/ nas khal nyis brgya/ gser srang bdun/ gser shog stong phon gsum sogs rgya cher stsal/ rgyal ba'i dbang po karma zhwa dmar pa dang*/ si tu sprul pa'i sku nas mdzo g.yag bco lnga/ dge slong bsod nams rgyal mtshan khu dbon nas ja 'khor drug nyi shu/ mar rgya nyis brgya/ tha mi ka kau ṭa gnyis sogs nye bar mkho ba'i rigs mang po'i gtong sgo stsal/ gzhan yang ldan yul stod smad kyi bla ma/ dpon mgo dgon sde/ sbyin bdag so so nas kyang zhal 'debs dngos rdzas kyi 'brel 'jog che phra mang du byung ba bcas/ dper na/ rgya mtsho chen po'i klong du chu rgyun nas chu thigs gcig cig yan chad gang lhung ba thams cad ro gcig tu 'dre ba ltar/ 'dir byung ngo cog gi dngos rdzas thams cad phyogs ris su bsdoms nas/ rten bzhengs 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi dgos ched du btang ba rnams ja'i rin thang du brtsis nas rags bsdus smos na/ thog mar 'gru dang rngad kyi shing gcod pa rnams dang*/ de'i 'go pa karma dpag bsam/ shākya byang chub/ lha gnyer ba/ rdzong nang ba/ dpon nor bu bcas dang*/ shing gzings pa/ gru pa/ shing bskyas par bcas pa'i gro zur chas/ gla rngan so so bsdoms pa ja 'khor drug sum cu/ las tshan gyi rkyen sel dbang bskur dang rjes gnang ba sa skya'i bla ma dang*/ gtsug lag khang rnying pa'i ar+gha'i cho ga sa chog pa/ gto bcos pa/ chos sgrogs pa/ dgon sde gzhan dang dgon pa gong 'og 'di dag tu las byed yon sbyor du bcas pa'i gegs sel sku rim pa rnams kyi gsol chas dang yon 'bul bsdoms pa ja 'khor drug sum cu rtsa lnga/ khang pa rnying pa bshig bskyas nas brtsams te gsar bzo sgo skas 'dzugs pa yan chad la/

rtse khog phyin nas ka bzhi chos 'khor yan chad kyi sde shogs re mos su/ las dka'i stabs bstun gyi 'u lag pa nyin rer shing nyis brgya nas sum brgya'i bar gang rigs bsags par/ nyin rer ja thug bcu re dang sde shogs so sor zur gsos su ja mar rtsam gsum mi grangs mang nyung bstun par gzabs/ shing gzhog pa/ brkos pa/ mgar ba dang bcas pa mi grangs sum cu yod par nyin rer ja thug phor pa nyi shu re/ rtsam pa bre re/ bag sreg re/ sha chang gi rgyug gang rigs re/ bar skabs su las tshegs che stabs kyis ston mo rnam gzhag bcas gzabs/ gzhan yang spen bad 'ching bsgrigs/ 'jim las pa/ ar+gha mkhan rnams te/ mdor na las byed 'u lag bcas pa'i mi grangs rgyas skabs kyi bza' bcas bsdoms pa nyin rer ja 'khor drug brgyad re 'gro ba/ de'i rtsis kyis nyi ma brgya dang gya brgyad kyi bza' bcas bsdoms pa ja 'khor drug chig stong dang lnga brgya bzhi'o// yon 'bul la shing bzo'i dpon bkra shis lo gnyis 'gor ba phyag dkar rnam gzhag yon 'bul bsdoms pa ja 'khor drug bcu bdun/ gyang bzo ba bzhir rnam gzhag yon 'bul bsdoms par ja 'khor drug dgu/ shing gzhog pa thams cad nyi ma brgya gya brgyad kyi yun thogs par rab mi rer nyi ma drug re la ja khag thob pa'i rtsis kyi mi bcu gsum gyi yon 'bul bsdoms pa ja 'khor drug brgya dang khag gnyis bar khag gi sum dum cha gcig 'bring mi rer nyi ma bdun re la bar khag thob rtsis kyi mi bcu la ja 'khor drug bzhi bcu dang bar khag phyed gnyis dang bar khag gi bdun dum gcig de mchan ma mi rer nyi ma dgu re la bar khag thob rtsis kyi mi bdun la ja 'khor drug sum cu rtsa drug dang khag gnyis bar khag gi dgu dum gcig ste/ shing bzo'i yon 'bul khyon bsdoms pa ja 'khor drug brgya don bdun dang khag gcig dang khag gcig gi dgu dum gcig go /mdor na gtsug lag khang rnying pa bshig pa nas brtsams te mthar phyin pa'i bar gyi bza' yon dgos spyad bcas yongs rdzogs bsdoms par ja 'khor drug chig stong bdun brgya bdun cu phyed don gsum dang khag gcig dang khag gcig gi dgu dum song ba ni nges pa'o// lha bzo ba rnams chu sprel lo'i hor zla gsum pa'i nyi shu gcig nas hor zla dgu pa'i nyi shu dgu bar nyi ma brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa dgur mchis par/

mi re la nyi ma lnga rer ja khag brtsis pas bar khag sum cu phyed so brgyad dang bcu cha gsum thob ste/ lha dpon gsum gyis mtshon pa'i mi nyi shu'i yon 'bul bsdoms pas ja 'khor drug nyis brgya lnga'i mal dang*/ de mchan ma zla zhag gi grangs gang bzhin las/ mi re la nyi ma drug rer ja khag brtsis pas bar khag sum cu phyed so gnyis thob/ mi nyer gcig gi yon 'bul bsdoms pa ja 'khor drug brgya dang phyed don dgu/ de mchan ma mi rer nyi ma brgyad rer ja khag brtsis pas bar khag phyed nyer bzhi dang brgyad dkrigs thob pa/ mi nyer gsum gyi yon 'bul bsdoms pa ja 'khor drug brgya re gcig go /gzhan yang lha dpon gyi rnam gzhag phyag dkar spyan 'byed rnams spyi lugs ltar ma chad par byas shing*/ gzungs zhugs 'dril ba rin chen chos 'dzin pa sogs mched grogs gsum/ ja 'khor drug dang*/ byin rlabs rten gyi sku brnyan 'debs pa'i 'go 'dzin nye bar gnas pa kun dga' bsam gtan grogs ldan bcas la ja 'khor drug drug dang*/ gzhan yang gser 'dul ba/ gser shog sbyor ba/ 'phen dang bla re sogs kyi tshem bu pa/ tshon rdung ba/ lder rdung ba/ gsol 'dren pa bcas grogs ldan pa rnams kyang so sor gang 'tsham gnang ster stsal ba bsdoms pa ja 'khor drug bzhi/ tshon gyi rin snga phyir bsdoms pa rags rtsis su ja 'khor drug brgya lnga bcu/ gser zhal gsol rgyur gser srang nyi shu rtsa gsum/ gser shog gi rin gser srang gsum mo// mdor na gtsug lag khang 'di bzo ba'i 'go brtsams nas bris 'bur gyi rten bzhengs mthar phyin pa'i bar gyi bza' btung yon 'bul dgos ched/ tshon gser bcas bsdoms pa la ja 'khor drug nyis stong bzhi brgya brgyad cu phyed rtsa lnga dang bar khag gi phyed dgu dum gcig bcas song ba ni nges pa nyid do// der yang rab gnas snga phyi rnams kyi 'bul ba gsol 'dren bcas ni mi brtsi ba'i dbang du byas pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/

rten bzhengs pa la rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga yang dag par rtsom pa la dgos pa shin tu yod de/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ gang du sku gzugs rdzogs pa la// byin ma brlabs par ring gnas na// de las bkra mi shes 'byung zhing*// ji srid mchod pa der mi 'os// dper na skyes bu la la zhig /rig pa'i mtshan nyid spangs pa na// 'jig rten kun gyis mchod mi byed// de de bzhin du gzugs brnyan de// rab gnas ma byas gzugs brnyan la// gang gis mchod cing phyag byed pa// dam tshig bral zhing sngags dman pas// sbyin sreg thal ba 'bras med mtshungs// zhes 'byung ba ltar rten la rab tu gnas pa'i cho gas byin gyis brlabs par ma byas par yun ring du gnas na/ der mi shis par 'byung ba dang mchod pa'i 'os su mi 'gyur te/ skyes bu blun po gzugs mdzes par gyur kyang mkhas pa rnams kyis bsngags 'os min pa ltar/ de srid du rten de'ang mchod pa'i gnas su mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// de ltar dgos pa can gyi rab tu gnas pa de la'ang ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ rab gnas rten dang slob dpon dus dang gnas// yo byad cho ga bzang po rnam pa drug /ces gsungs pa ltar bzang po drug ldan te/ de'ang rten bzang po ni gong du smos pa'i sku gsung thugs rten tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa de dag go /slob dpon bzang po ni/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ slob dpon de nyid bcu shes shing*// mtshan nyid kun dang yang dag ldan// phyag rgya sngags dang cho ga shes// las rnams kun la mkhas pas so// zhes sogs rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid rnams kyi dri bzang gis gos dogs ma mchis mod/ kho bo cag la sogs pa gzhi'i bsnyen pa sngon du song ba/ skabs su bab pa'i cho ga la ma rmongs pa dge slong dgon sde zung la gang dag bzhugs pa rnams bsags so// dus bzang po ni/ krī ya sa muts+tsha las/ mchu dang dbo yi zla ba de bzhin nges par sa ga snron dang chu stod zla ba dang*// mgo ste de srid 'di rnams dge ba gcig pus 'bras bu ster ba'i zla ba drug tu gsungs// zhes 'byung ba dang*/

yang lo re la bgrod pa gnyis las/ bkra shis pa dang rgyas pa'i las thams cad nyi ma byang bltas kyi dus su shis par gsungs kyang*/ 'dir rten bzhengs nas ring du mi 'gyangs par shis pa'i lung gtsor bzung nas/ kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyis lha las babs pa'i dus bzang yod pa'i tha skar gyi zla ba ste/ de'i yang*/ dkyil 'khor dang ni rab gnas pa// yar gyi ngo la brtag par bya// gza' skar lhag pa 'dzom gyur na// mar ngo la yang nyes pa med// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ phyogs snga ma'i bzang po gsum pa'i tshes/ dar gud lang tsho/ nyi ma stag shar ba la/ gza' skar yang de nyid las/ phur bu lhag pa pa wa sangs// zla ba'i gza' sogs shes bya ste// gza' skar 'di rnams la byas na// rab tu gnas pa mchog tu dge /zhes 'byung ba lta bu'i gza' pa wa sangs dang*/ skar ma yang*/ thams cad du ni chu stod dang*// skar ma de bzhin gro bzhin dbo// lag snron dag dang snubs dang ni// rgyal dang chu smad de bzhin no// khrums smad dag kyang de bzhin te// zhes bshad pa'i rgyu skar rags par khrums stod/ zhib par khrums smad/ 'phrod chen rgyal mtshan/ khams sbyor rgyas las 'grub pa'i dus tshod phun sum tshogs pa zhig tu'o// gnas bzang po ni/ gzhung rin chen 'bar bar/ gnas ni yid 'ong 'du 'dzi sogs// skyon med rnam mdzes bla khab can// zhes dang*/ rdo rje me long las/ ri bo phyogs sogs 'byor pa mod// ljon shing me tog rgyas pa'i tshal// tsan+dan dri bsung ldan pa'i ri// bdag dbang bar gcod med pa'i gnas// zhes gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa'i gnas yid du 'ong ba/ chos ldan sa 'dzin gyi dbang pos bskyangs shing rang dbang yod par bla khab dang ldan pa ste/ med na'ang phyar ther la sogs pa'i thog phub can du dgos pa las de dag ci rigs pa tshang ba'i gan+dho la nyid du'o// yo byad ni dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i yo byad dang rab tu gnas pa la nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad dang*/

sbyin sreg dang 'brel ba'i yo byad rnams te/ de dag kyang dngos po bzang zhing gya nom pa ma tshang ba med par nyer bsdogs su byas so// cho ga bzang po ni de nyid las/ cho ga dag dang ldan pas bya// cho ga dman pas mi bya ste// rab gnas rtag par mi shis 'gyur// 'jig rten 'dir yang sdug bsngal la// 'jig rten pha rol 'jigs pa che// de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis// dngos grub 'dod pas nan tan bya// zhes cho ga rnam par dag cing lag len phra mo tshun chad ma 'khrul ba zhig la brten nas byin rlabs 'byung dgos pa'i phyir/ rgyud sde so so'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga mang du mchis pa las/ 'dir 'phags yul gyi slob dpon chen po rnams kyi gzhung*/ chos kyi rgyal po sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa gsal bar byed pa'i mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug ngor chen yab sras kyi gsung rab dri mas dben par brten/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal pos bstan pa'i dpal kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga shin tu rgyas pas gtsug lag khang du nyin gsum pa tshar gcig dang*/ lam 'bras lha khang du'ang de 'dra ba tshar gcig bgyis so// slar yang lo de nyid kyi hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan chos skyong bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa nyid ljongs 'dir bsod nams kyi 'do li la brten nas spyan drangs te/ tshes bcu dgur kye rdor sta gon tshugs pa'i tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon chen por bzhugs te/ ldan phrug bdag dang*/ chos rje rin chen lhun grub/ rab bkram bla ma bstan 'dzin phun tshogs sogs dang*/ rag co chos sde'i dge slong bsnyen song gang dag bzhugs pa bcas te gtsug lag khang du rab gnas rgyas pa nyin gsum pa zhig dang*/

mgon khang du rab gnas thun mong min pa nyin gang pa zhig mdzad do// chu bya lor hor zla bcu pa'i tshes la mkhan po chen po thams cad mkhyen pa dpon g.yog dang sde dge sa skyong bla ma lcam dral sku 'khor dang bcas pa lhan cig tu spyan 'dren gsol ba btab par brtse bas rjes su dgongs pas ljongs 'dir chibs kyi kha lo sgyur ba'i bka' drin stsal/ ji ltar bskrun pa'i gan+dho la pho brang bcas dang*/ bris 'bur rten bzhengs kyi dngos po rnams/ gtsug lag lugs brgya dpyod pa'i 'dren byed dbang po dkyus su spros pa'i g.yar lam du gzigs pas legs par phab par phyogs thams cad nas dgyes par gyur pa'i swasti sgra dbyangs snyan pa'i rgyud stong 'khrol bas/ do dam pa rgan po khu tshar bcas pa'i snying la sngon med kun dga'i lang tsho'i bcud len gyi zil dngar 'dzad pa med pa'i dga' ston ci yang stsal ba dang*/ gtsug lag khang du stong 'khun yul du btags pa'i gos bzang rdo rje srang lam ma'i bla re/ gos 'phan bzhi/ sku brnyan che rags rnams la mdzod dar gyis mtshon pa'i kha dog lnga pa'i snyan shal 'bul ba dang*/ gtsug lag khang du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi po ti sum brgya bcu bdun gdong dar dbu dar glegs shing glegs thag bcas kyi gtan bzhag dang*/ de dag gi mdun du mar me rgyun 'bar gyi rten 'jog pa dang*/ lha khang steng du gser gyi 'gan 'ji ra sogs gnang ba'i bka' lung gnang ster bzang po bcas stsal/ 'dir 'khod kyi bla ma dpon po/ dgon sde/ yul mir bcas nas mchod yon 'dir phyogs phebs pa'i legs 'bul so so nas gzabs pa'i khul byas song*/ de skabs nas kyang mkhan po rin po che gtso bor bzhugs nas/ bla ma dge slong gi tshogs dang bcas pas/ lam 'bras sku brnyan gsar bskrun rnams dang lha khang steng shod bcas la rab gnas nyin gang pa lan gcig ste/

snga phyir rab gnas lan bzhir song bas/ bris 'bur gyi rten ji snyed bzhugs pa rnams kyi rdul phra rab kyi go rer yang rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed kyi grangs su mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gis mngon par gtams pa'i bdag nyid can du bsgrubs so// des na rten dang brten par bcas pa 'di dag ni legs bris kyi dbang po rnams dang*/ mi'i dbang po rnams dang*/ gdengs can gyi dbang po rnams dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gsum gyi skye 'gro ma lus pas phyag bya ba'i 'os dang*/ mchod cing brjod par bya ba'i 'os dang*/ bkur stir bya ba'i 'os dang*/ ri mor bya ba'i 'os bla na med pa'i mchod sdong chen po nyid du gyur pa ni gdon mi za ba'o// smras pa/

chos dpe/ bgyi ba kun la skye nas skyer// legs par sbyangs ltar rig pa'i gnas// de der sgrin pa'i blo ldan gyis// skye bos khor yug rnam mdzes de// de na rgyal khyad 'phags phul byung*/ ba'i myu gu yi// skye bar ldan pa'i sa skyong gang*// bsod nams pha mtha' nam mkhas kyang*// mtshon pa min pa'i mthu las byung*// chos bsdus dang ma bsdus bsres pa'i gzugs can/ phyir gtong phod rmad byung gi /dpag bsam yal ga brkyangs pa las// longs spyod ci 'dod char che bas// re ba'i 'thu ba ci yang dgang*// snying sems ldan rab rtog pos rnam dben zang zing gis// rten dang brten pa'i sprul sku'i zhing*// sprul pa 'di 'dra mes pos kyang*// dang por ma shes 'gyod pas sad// ye rigs brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed/ shes dag pa'i rang snang gi /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras slob bcas// nam yang gzhan du mi bzhud par// brtan bzhugs cho ga'i rgya yis btab// sgyu ma'i dpa' bo'i nyams ldan/ sngags kyis btab pa med// bi shwa karma sa stengs 'dir// 'phos pa min par 'jig rten khams// snying pos ljid 'di su zhig byas// sde bya ba brjod pa tha ma'i gsal byed/ bzhi phun sum tshogs pa'i stobs// dge bcus slar yang brling gyur pa// sa spyod bye ba'i thor tshugs rtser// ngal gsor byas pa de yis so// zhes gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i gleng ba kun dga'i 'dzum zer 'dzag pa'i zla gzhon las bgyi ba mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'i sarga ste bzhi pa'o// //spyi don lnga pa mjug ni/ phan yon bstan pa dang*/ bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba'o// dang po ni rang re lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gsum na dkon mchog gsum las lhag pa'i skyabs gnas su gyur pa 'ga' yang 'byung ba med pa'i phyir dang*/ nyes pa bag chags bcas pa yongs su zad par gyur pa'i phyir dang*/

yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur pa'i phyir dang*/ lam gsum khongs na gang dang mtshungs pa'i lham mer snang ba'i rgyan mchog tu gyur pa gzhan med pa'i phyir dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi rten dang gling dang dpung gnyen gyi mchog gcig pur gyur pa'i phyir dang*/ rnam pa thams cad du mchog gi gnas las nam yang 'pho ba'am 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir te/ de skad du rgyud bla mar/ 'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir// mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi// rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir// 'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid// ces so// des na mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pa'i dkon mchog gsum skyabs kyi dam par bzung ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa dag dkon mchog gsum gyi bsti gnas gan+dho la bzheng ba dang*/ dkon mchog gi rten gsum bzheng ba dang*/ phyag mchod kyis bsnyen bkur zhing sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byas pas 'bras bu bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang gegs med du 'grub par 'gyur te/ phal po che las/ rigs par ldan pa dkon mchog gsum rnams la// sbyor ba skyo ba med pas mchod byas na// de dag bdud bzhi'i lam las rab 'das nas// byang chub bla med myur du reg par 'gyur// zhes so// des na bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan gyis mngon par lham pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rten du gtogs pa dag bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhengs te tshogs bsags dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrubs pa'i phan yon bka' dang bstan bcos dri ma med pa rnams las rgya cher 'byung ba 'dir yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir mdo tsam brjod na/ de la'ang rten gtsug lag khang gi dang*/ brten pa rten gsum gyis phan yon gnyis las/ dang po dkon mchog gsum gyi bsti gnas gtsug lag khang byed pa ni/ skye ba nas skye bar lha'i khang bzang lta bu'i gnas la dbang bar 'gyur te/

gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad par/ mi rnams gang dag rgyal ba'i gtsang khang byed// de dag 'gro ba rnams su 'khor ba na// lha dbang gnas 'dra'i khang khyim 'od 'bar ba// dus tshigs kun tu bde ldan thob par 'gyur// zhes so// der sangs rgyas kyi yon tan sna tshogs pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba'ang*/ ji skad du/ su zhig sangs rgyas mchod rten sku gzugs khang*// tshon rtsi sna tshogs rnams kyis mdzes byed pa// de ni bde gshegs mnga' ba'i yon tan rnams// sna tshogs ldan pa kun gyis brtsigs par 'gyur// zhes so// des bsod nams tshad med par thob par 'gyur ba ni/ mkhas pa dpa' bos/ thub pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bcas/ gtsug lag khang gi don du ni// tshig gis rab tu bskul ba dang*// tshogs pa yi ni grogs byed cing*// nges par dus su 'gro byed pa// gnyid log pa'am langs pa na// bsod nams rgyun ni tshad med 'phel// zhes so// gnyis pa brten pa rten gsum las/ sku'i rten byed pa ni/ gang zhig sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rgyu rin po che gser la sogs pa las 'bur du bskrun pa'am ri mor bris pa'i bsod nams gang gis bskal pa mang por bsgrub par dka' ba'i dge tshogs rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son par 'gyur te/ dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa phyag rgya'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi phye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi rang sangs rgyas dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang*/ de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams yin par byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang la la zhig sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs gcig ri mor bris pa 'di ni de bas bsod nams grangs med pa bskyed do// zhes so// chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ba ni/

ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdor/ sangs rgyas sku gzugs shin tu mdzes pa dag /rin chen byi dor legs par byas pa yang*// lta na sdug cing shin tu mdzes par gyis// ring por mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog 'di thob// de bzhin gser dag dang ni dngul dag dang*// tsan+dan gyis ni sku gzugs bzang po dag /mdzes shing shin tu lta na sdug pa gyis// ring por mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog 'di thob// 'jim pa dang ni de bzhin rdo ba dang*// shing la ri mor byas pa'i sku gzugs kyang*// mdzes shing shin tu lta na sdug pa gyis// ring por mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog 'di thob// ces so// bsgrub par bya ba'i snying po mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi mchog kyang thob par 'gyur te/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las/ la las der ni rin chen sna bdun dang*// la las de bzhin zangs dang khar ba las// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi gzugs byas pa// de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur// ro nye dang ni lcags sam sa yang rung*// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi gzugs byas te// lta na sdug pa 'jim pa'i las byed bcug /de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur// gang gi rtsig ngos gzugs kyi ri mo dag /bsod nams brgya mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku// bdag gis bris sam 'dri ru bcug kyang rung*// de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur// zhes so// de bzhin du/ ji skad du/ sdug bsngal dag ni thams cad dang*// sgrib pa kun sel dam pa'i chos// zhes gsungs pa ltar dam pa'i chos ni sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa mthar 'byin cing thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi bar mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thob par byed pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ gsung rten glegs bam bris pa dang mchod pa'i phan yon ni/ bskal pa du mar yang brjod kyis mi ldang ste/ sgo mtha' yas par sgrub pa'i gzungs las/

mdo sde thos nas rjes su yi rang dang*// yi ger bris dang gzung dang bklags pa yi// bsod nams chu bo ji tsam bskyed pa ni// sems can kun gyis shes par yongs mi nus// de ni tshe rabs kun du rgyal ba mthong*// de dag la yang dad pa bsam yas rnyed// mdo sde zab mo'i tshul yang shes par 'gyur// de ni myur du byang chub mchog 'tshang rgya// bla med byang chub ma reg bar du yang*// de ni ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes dang*// gzungs rnams dang ni gzugs dang longs spyod dang*// sangs rgyas mthong las nyams par yongs mi 'gyur// zhes sogs so// de bzhin du mchod rten zhes pa spyir rten gsum ga la 'jug mod/ 'dir chos sku'i rten mchod rten gyi phan yon ni/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus par/ thub dbang mchod rten byed pa'i mi rnams ni// mya ngan yongs med lus kun brtan pa dang*// longs spyod mchog dang rin chen mdzod mang ldan// dgra yi tshogs rnams kyang ni thub par 'gyur// rgyal ba'i mchod rten srog shing phul ba yis// chos dang rjes mthun chos la sgrub pa dang*// tshul khrims thos dang bzod pa'i mchog dang ldan// 'jig rten dag na don kun 'grub par 'gyur// zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher 'byung mod 'dir yi ge mangs kyi dogs pas re zhig de tsam mo// mdor na rten dang brten pa'i ngo mtshar mchod rten gyi phreng ba 'di dag phyi dbyibs bzo tshad mtshan nyid tshad mar gyur pa'i lung don dang rjes su mthun par byas pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas khyad par 'phags pa'i phyir dang*/ nang rten de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i ring bsrel byin rlabs kyi rten rin thang gzhal du med pa'i phung po tshogs pa'i snying po can du gyur pas khyad par 'phags pa'i phyir dang*/ gsang bar ye shes 'khor lo gzhug pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga yang yang bgyis pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab 'byams mu med kyis mngon par gtams pas khyad par 'phags pa'i phyir dang*/

gang dag ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i yi ge tshar du dngar ba dag gis gsol ba btab na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal gyi chu klung bye ba'i 'bab stegs su gyur pa'i phyir na/ srid pa gsum po ma lus pas sna tshogs mchod pa'i phreng bas mdun bdar te dang ba'i yid kyis bkur stir bgyid pa'i mchod sdong bla na med par gyur pa'i rten 'di dag la/ me tog la sogs pa zang zing gi mchod pa dang phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa bkur sti'i mchod pa gang byas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa nyid 'jig rten du bzhugs pa dang khyad par med pa nyid du grub ste/ mdo sde mya ngan las 'das par/ dga' bo gal te skyes bu zhig gis dad pa'i sems kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung phyed dam/ bzhi cha gcig gam/ drug cha'am/ brgya'i cha'am/ stong gi cha'am/ khri'i cha'am/ klung gaṅgā'i bye ma'i cha gcig nas/ chung ngu na yungs 'bru tsam gcig la dad pa'i sems kyis bsti stang dang bcas/ rim gro dang bcas/ mchod pa dang bstod pa byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa la bsti stang dang bcas pas mchod pa byas na/ skyes bu de gnyis kyi bsod nams ni thams cad khyad par med par mnyam ste/ tshad med dpag tu med do// zhes dang*/ gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa las/ su dag dkon mchog gsum la me tog dang*// 'bras bu gsar thog byung ba 'bul byed pa// de dag 'gro ba rnams su 'khor ba na// ro mchog kun thob mi brdzi stobs dang ldan// phreng ba rgyan chen me tog char rnams kyis// su dag 'dir ni rgyal ba'i gzugs la mchod// de dag lha dang mi yi 'jig rten du// cha byad yid 'ong sna tshogs legs par brgyan// zhes so// de bas na mthong chos slad mar bcas pa la legs par 'dod pa'i blo gros can dag rten gsum khyad par can rnams la dang ba'i sems kyis bsti stang dang bcas pas phyag mchod bskor ba byas pa/

de las bsod nams kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ dpag tu med pa dang grangs med par thob par 'gyur te/ lung gzhi las/ mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dang bas// sangs rgyas mchod rten la ni gom 'dor na// 'dzam bu chu bo gser gyi srang tshad ni// stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min// zhes so// der srid pa kun du legs bris pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mchod par 'gyur ba nas mthar thug mtshan gyis brgyan pa'i sku thob pa'i bar gyi yon tan thob par 'gyur te/ spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdor/ mchod rten bskor ba byas na ni// tshe rabs dag ni thams cad du// lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang*// srin po rnams kyis mchod par 'gyur// ngas ni gang dag bstan pa yi// mi khom brgyad po de dag spong*// sangs rgyas 'byung ba rab mdzes pa// mnyes par byed 'di dal ba gcig /mdog ldan gzugs ni phun sum tshogs// mtshan gyis legs par brgyan pa dang*// mthu dang stobs dang ldan par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad par/ su zhig dad pas thub pa'i mchod rten nam// sku gzugs dag la bskor ba byed pa de// phyi ma'i tshe la dgra chen rnams kyis btud// bzang po'i snod gyur yon tan rnams dang ldan// zhes dang*/ mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'i mdor/ mchod rten bskor ba byas pa yis// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// lha min mkha' lding mi'am ci// lto 'phye rnams kyang mchod byed 'gyur// zhes pa nas/ mchod rten bskor ba byas pas ni// 'jig rten dag tu de bzhin gshegs// mtshan rnams kyis ni brgyan pa dang*// gser gyi sku mdog thob par 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar gyis gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i phan yon rgya cher bstan to// des na skal ba mi dman pa dag dkon mchog gsum gtan gyi skyabs su bzung nas/

deng 'dir rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge'i sku 'di nyid la gtsug lag khang 'di'i phyi rol nas bskor ba bsags pa'i dbang du byas na bskor ba lnga stong brgyad brgya dang gsum gyi nang du bskor grangs 'bum phrag gcig dang nyag ma bcug cig 'gro rtsis dang*/ tshe dpag med dang sangs rgyas byams pa gnyis gang rigs la bskor ba bsags na bzhi stong bdun brgya re gnyis kyi nang du bskor ba 'bum phrag gcig dang nyag ma gnyis 'gro ba nges par shar ro// de'i nang gses su zhar byung rten gzhan che phra gang dag bzhugs pa rnams la bskor ba 'bum phrag mang po lhan cig tu 'gro ba the tshom bya mi dgos so// de lta bas na dal 'byor gyi mi lus las snying po dam pa blang bar 'dod pa'i rnam dpyod yid srubs grogs po'i dbang du ma song ba'i legs byas kyi bgo skal ldan pa rnams kyis gong du drangs pa'i phan yon bsnyad pa dri ma med pa'i lung don rjes su dran pa'i yid ches khyad par can bskyed kyin/ zang zing gi sgo nas me tog dang spos dang mar me la sogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ lus kyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal bskor bas bkur stir bgyid pa lhur len pa 'tshal lo// gnyis pa la/ bsngo ba'i dgos pa/ rnam gzhag skabs su bab pa'i bsngo ba'o// dang po ni de ltar dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rnams sgo gsum longs spyod dang bcas pa'i sgo nas mngon par bskrun pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba dpag tu ma mchis pa yod mod/ de nyid byang chub kyi bar du bar ma dor chud mi 'dza' zhing*/ stobs dang ldan par bsgyur ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo bas rgyas gdab dgos te/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar chu thigs rgya mtsho che nang lhung*// rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad// de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang*// byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// khyad par dge ba yongs su bsngo ba nyid ni mu stegs byed kyi gzhung du ma grags par/

thams cad mkhyen pa kho na'i khyad par gyi chos yin te/ khyad par 'phags pa'i bstod pa las/ bsod nams byas pa'i tshogs dag ni// sems can rnams la yongs bsngo ba// de gzhan bstan bcos las ma bshad// ces 'byung ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la/ bsngo bya'i dge rtsa/ bsngo ba'i yul/ ji ltar bsngo ba gsum las/ dang po la dbye na/ sbyin pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ tshul khrims las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po/ bsgoms pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po ste gsum las/ 'dir skabs su bab pa ni dang po ste/ de la'ang*/ zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// zhes pa ltar bzhi las/ 'dir ni bzhi ga tshang ba'i sgo nas nges par bsgrub dgos shing*/ de'i nang gses su'ang 'dir bsgrub bar bya ba dam pa'i chos nas bstan pa'i dge ba dang*/ de sgrub pa'i thabs su gyur pa zang zing gi sbyin pa gtong ba ste gnyis po gtso che ba nyid do// de la'ang 'dir bgyis pa'i bsod nams kho nar ma zad de/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pas gang dag bsags pa thams cad kyang bsngor btub ste/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi mdor/ tha dad phyogs nas chu klung mang po dag /rgya mtsho cher 'bab ro gcig gyur pa ltar// tha dad phyogs nas dge ba bsags byas pa// byang chub bsngos pa rnams kyang ro gcig 'gyur// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ dge ba de dag kyang legs bris bdag po dang*/ lag 'gro'i dbang po dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba dang*/ khams kyi rgyal phran la sogs pa/ 'jig rten pa'i che 'byor can du gtogs pa rnams dang*/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal ba'i 'phags pas mtshon pa'i zhi bde lhur len pa rnams kyi sar nam yang mi bsngo bar/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na'i sar bsngo ba ni lam ma nor ba ste/ mgon po byams pas/ khams gsum gtogs pa ma yin dang*// zhes dang*/

rgyal ba'i yum las/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa yin no zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ tha snyad du/ ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i dge ba thams cad mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas bla na med pa'i byang chub myur du thob pa'i phyir bsngo'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa can te/ spyod 'jug las/ dngos sam yang na brgyud kyang rung*// sems can don las gzhan mi spyad// sems can kho na'i don gyi phyir// thams cad byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes so// de las gcig shos su chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin bdag med pa'i shes rab zab mos/ 'dir dngos po dang bsam pa dang yul te 'khor gsum po yongs su dag pa'i tshul gyis mi dmigs pa ste/ sdud pa las/ gal te 'di ltar chos 'di 'gags shing zad pa dang*// gang du yongs su bsngo ba de yang zad pa dang*// chos kyi chos la nam yang mi bsngo shes gyur na// de ltar rab tu shes pas yongs su bsngos pa yin// zhes dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las/ de ni dmigs med rnam pa can// phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do// zhes so// des na dmigs pa'i dug dang bral ba sgyu ma'i rnam pa lta bur yongs su shes pas te/ mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te// rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas// de la ji bzhin snang ba gang yang med// chos rnams thams cad de 'drar shes par gyis// zhes 'byung ste/ de dag gis ni rnam par gzhag pa'i gleng ba nyung zad kyis mdun bsu ba'o// //swasti sid+dhi rastu/ dpag

rgya che ba'i rgyan las bsam pa rgya ches spud pa/ yas phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' mu med du// yongs khyab zhing na 'tsho gzhes rdzogs sangs rgyas// phyogs bral 'gro la gzigs pa dag pa'i spyan// gzhar yang 'dzums pa mi mnga' ji snyed dang*// yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs can gyis mdzes pa/ sems can smad 'dogs sgrub pa dam bca'i mdud// lhod med snying la btab pa rgyal ba'i sras// slob ma thos sgrogs rnams dang rkyen gcig rtogs// dam can srung ma ngag gi mtshon ldan bcas// yan lag gnyis pa'i gzugs can/ 'di na tshur dgongs sa la spyod pa'i sdeṃ// rgyal thabs dgeṃ ba'i spyod pas skyong brtson pa// thub pa'i gdung 'tshob sā la'i nags stug las// legs mdzad bsil ba'i bsung zhim ci yang ldang*// bde bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ gshegs sras spyod chu gter zab rgya che// spyod pa rmad byung lhun pos bsrubs las skyes// rten dang der brten mchod sdong zla ba gsar// las bzang bde 'byung thor tshugs rgyan 'di 'khrungs// dge 'byung 'gyur 'gog pa/ ba'i rtsa ba thams cad mkhyen rgyu ru// yongs su bsgyur min de srid ltar snang bde// gyi nar spyad sogs 'dzad 'gyur tshad ma'i mchid// gang phyir bsod nams yongs bsngor spro ba brtas// brtsams ting nge 'dzin gyi rab brtag pa rmad byung gis mtshon srid dang zhi'i// legs byas phyogs re'i mtha' yang ring song ba'i// pha rol 'tshol du phyin pa'i sngo bsangs mkha'// dngos po kun gyi chos nyid brdzus sam snyam// bsam pa rgya che ba/ mchog gi sar phyin che ba'i yon tan gter// 'dzad bral 'phrin du shod tsam ma yin par// mtha' klas sems can re skong thams cad mkhyen// rang gzhan kun gyis bde blag thob phyir bsngo// bla med 'di nas brtsams te shis par brjod pa gzugs brnyan gyi dga' ba'i shis brjod/

'bras bu re zhig blta dka' mod// 'on te thos bsam bsgom pa'i stobs bdo bas// 'jig rten khams su phan dang bde 'byung gnas// rgyal bstan bskal pa'i srid du ring 'tshor shog / yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs can gyi shis brjod/ ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i yul 'jal ba'i// mkhyen rab 'dom dkyus ring mo khyod la deng*// yongs su rdzogs zhes bla ma lhag pa'i lhas// yi ge dam pas rab bsngags sa skya pa'i// de yon tan lhan cig brjod pa/ bstan mngon rjes tshad ma'i lung dag gis// yongs dpyad rtsod pa kun las grol ba'i chos// de 'dzin sgrub dang bshad pa lhur len pa'i// mchu 'dab snyung ba lhan cig dar bab shog /dpal yon tan gyi rang bzhin brjod pa/ stug nga dang bzhed pa mnyam nyid du// legs 'doms rgyal po kun dga' bzang po zhes// bka' lung dbyangs kyi rgyal mo dgyes pa'i glu// tshogs gsum gdangs su bsgyur ba e waṃ pa// de yan lag gcig gzugs can/ gsungs yang dag rig nas smra ba'i sgo// 'jam dpal ye shes sor mo'i 'phrul phye ba// 'dus pa li khri'i tshon gyis 'od srungs byin// phyogs bral kun du bklubs pas mdzes gyur cig / shis par brjod pa/ skye 'phags mkhas pa kuṃn dgaṃ'i bloṃ groṃs daṃng*// mthuṃ stoṃbs grub pa'i dbaṃng phyugaṃ zung mnyam nyid// legs dgu rtag tu dar bab cho ga de// mkha' khyab rgyal ba kun gyis sgrubs shig gu// rab tu spel ba/ dpaṃl ldaṃn stobs bcu'i dbang phyug thams cad kyi// yon tan gcig tu gyur pa'i ngur smrig 'chang*// mchog gi rol pas choṃs tshul skyoṃng ba che// gsang gsum zho 'thungs rus pa'i rdo rjer shog / ldan pa'i gzugs can/ kunaṃ dgaṃ'i dpal 'byung rgyal ba'i phriṃn laṃs pa// dgongs pa chos dbyings rgyaṃ mtshoṃ mnyam gzhag par// dpag yas dge ba'i chu klung yongs btung bas// yon tan rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas gyur cig

/ 'byor pa rgya che ba/ mtshar sdug pa tra'i sgeg mo glog 'gyur mas// ring thang tshad las 'das pa nor bu'i rigs// sna tshogs dam du 'khyud mdzes gser gyi khri// mi bdag bye bas bteg pa ga la bar// yid yan lag gcig gzugs can/ 'phrog phrin las grub pa rgyal ba'i sras// gtsug lag dpyod pa'i bloṃ groṃs rnam gsal gang*// rgyaṃ mtshoṃ'i gos can nam zhig gnas kyi bar// 'tsho ba'i dpag bsam ring por tshugs gyur cig / bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ mi dman bsoṃd naṃms brgyas bskrun legs bris bu// las shugs dar bab 'chi med mgoṃn poṃ gang*// sku 'tsho gzhom bral yon tan bdun ldan du// brtan byed zil dngar btung ba rtag rol shog /de rigs mtha' dag gzugs can/ mi zad rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i mdza'// choṃs srid ku mud skyoṃng ba mtshan mo'i mgoṃn// chab 'bangs sgrol byed phreng ba rnam bkra'i dbus// las bzang snang ba mu med phyogs su spros/ /ma bsdus shing bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ byams brtse'i rtsibs ma stong ldan dkar po'i gdugs// sa steng skye 'gro'i bla nas blar 'phags pa'i// phrin las bsil ba'i grib mar gangs can 'gro// ngal gso skyid pa'i ga zha 'byin gyur cig /sngon mtha' dag gzugs can/ bsags bsoṃd naṃms 'chi med btung ba'i ros// mkhyen dpyod kho lag rdzogs pa'i dpung sbom gyis// bstan srid mi nub rgyaṃl mtshaṃn dgung sngon mthongs// legs slong srog gi ljon shing brling gyur cig / rigs mthun ldog pa can/ kunaṃ mkhyen bstan la dgaṃ' dang gus pa'i sems// nyams byed rtsub mo'i 'drud pas mi dbye zhing*// sgrib byed stug po'i tshon gyis 'gog min par// lhan skyes dge ba'i bloṃ groṃs rgyal gyur cig /zla ba'i dngos po'i dpe/ ma mar che ba'i chu klung nas// chung ngu dag byed zegs ma gcig lhung bzhin// khur len bya byed zang zing che chung 'brel// mchis dgu bla med byang chub smin gyur cig

/ bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ gangs ljongs mtho ris dga' tshal rab yangs par// mar gyur lus can lha bu grangs med dag /phan tshun byams pa rmad byung lag sbrel te// bde dgas cher myos gar gyis rtsen par shog / mi sdug nyams ldan/ gdon bgegs 'byung po sha khrag rngom pa'i kha// gnam sa bar du glal ba'i na bun che// 'khrigs pa'i pho nya nad dang bkres rngabs dang*// gsod gcod g.yul gyi 'khor lo zhig gyur cig /dkar cha shas kyi gzugs can/ po'i phyogs kyi tshogs bzang gzhon nu rnams// sprin sngon rnga yab kyis gtor lha yi chus// nor ldan brtan ma'i bzhin ras yongs bkrus pas// phun tshogs lo legs dga' ston ci yang bsu// rkang pa bzhi gar yod pa chod pa'i zung ldan/ sgrib gnyis stug po'i mun pa yongs za ba'i// tshogs gnyis zung 'jug snang ba'i sgron ma spun// sku gnyis grub pa'i shing rta la chibs nas// don gnyis mdzad pa'i 'od stong 'bar gyur cig / yan lag gnyis pa'i gzugs can/ byang chub snying po grub pa de srid bdag /dal 'byor lus mchog tshulaṃ khriṃms gsum gyis 'byor// bcu phrag rig pa'i riṃn chenaṃ 'od snang gis// chos kyi 'dab stong bzhad pa nyid gyur cig /srid pa min pa'i dpe/ kun phan dkyil 'khor gyis bskyed mi bzad dug /dpag bsam yongs 'du las ni dbul phongs bzhin// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas bslus pa'i gtam// srid pa min pas smras don 'grub gyur cig /ces 'phags pa'i yul gyi snyan dngags smra ba kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu dpal ldan daṇ+ḍī'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung gi rjes su 'brangs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa yid 'phrog tshangs pa'i bu mo'i rgyud las 'phos pa'i dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba'i smon lam mdo tsam btab pa lags/ smras pa/ zhing mang ba'i dpe rgyan/ gi rdul phran grangs snyed dang*// dri gzhon lam gyi pha rol bzhin// mi mchog rnams kyi rten gsum phreng*// bskrun pa'i las bzang grangs mthas dben// kun

sh+lau ka gnyis rab rtog gsal byed kyi sgras zin pa/ mkhyen ye shes snang ba yi// khor yug las kyang bskal pa'i 'phrin// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos phung gi /tshad mas lan brgyar 'bod kyis dogs// de skad shod phyir dri khyer khams// dngos pos dben pa'i stang stabs kyis// kun du 'phyan pas ngal ba'i dbugs// shugs ring 'byin pa yin nam snyam// dge ba mchog gis nges par bstan pa/ yongs bsngo'i rgyas gdab pa// gzhan don byang chub cher smin pa// 'gyur byed kyis zin lo ha'i khams// bum pa brgya skyes 'gyur bar mtshon// mngon de nyid brjod pa'i dpe/ par 'dod pa sde bzhi'i dpal// 'thob byed lag pa'i stabs mtshungs kyang*// min no rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rnams// smon lam thabs la mkhas pas yin// zhes gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i gleng ba kun dga'i 'dzum zer 'dzag pa'i zla gzhon las mjug phan yon bstan pa'i sarga ste lnga pa'o// //slar yang 'dir smras pa/ phul bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ byung yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i byin rlabs snang byed 'od kyi zer// su zhig gtsug tu 'bab stegs byas 'phral skye ba lu gu rgyud kyi sdig /bag la nyal bcas mun pa yongs zos phan bde'i ge sar rgyal mtshan tshal// bgrang yas cig car bzhad pa'i rgyal po dkon mchog gsum gyi nyin mor byed// gang dag rigs brjod pa bar gyi gsal byed/ gtan gyi skyabs su nges bzung sems dpa' che'i// rigs mchog snying stobs dge bas rab rling sa skyong gis// gnyis med gsung bas drug cu'i gdangs su legs gdams chos// dbyig 'dzin khongs 'dir bskal pa brgya phrag 'tsho gzhes slad// gzugs can ting nge 'dzin bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa gsum gyi rab spel/ de 'dzin dam pa srid pa spangs pa'i brtul zhugs tshon// phyogs mtshams sgeg mo'i mkhur tshos la bsgos thun mtshams kyi// lang tsho'i mtshar sdug mdzes pa ci yang ngom pa'i tshogs// klog spong 'khor lo zung gis rnam par rtsen pa'i ched//

'byor pa rgya che ba/ gnam sngon zhun ma 'khyil pa'i khyams su ba gam dang*// pha gu gser gdung lan kan khor yug bkod pa mtho// nor bu'i ka gdung grangs med kyis brling rta babs sgo// dril chung dam pa'i chos kyi dbyangs su 'jo bas mdzes// rgyal nges pa'i dpe rgyan/ dang de sras zhi khro bgrang las rnam brgal ba'i// snang brnyan bkod pa gcig tu tshogs pa'i ngo mtshar 'di// snang srid dngos po rnam gsal 'phrul gyi ma gu ra// gcig pus mtshon las gzhan pa'i dpe zlas dben pa gang*// gya 'byor pa rgya che bar rab rtog gis spras pa/ nom dngos po gzhaṃn gyis gang dag 'byor dgu dang*// sgyuṃ 'phruṃl yid kyis mngon par sprul pa nam mkha'i mdzod// cir yang dgyes dgur spyod la mngoṃn dgaṃ'i gan+dhoṃ la// dbang byed gnas bzang bod yul chen por 'phos snyam 'di// mi ldan pa'i gzugs can/ mngon par bskrunaṃ paṃ'i ya mtshan gang laṃs 'phroṃs paṃ'i gtam// gleṃng baṃ tshogs gsum rgyud mangs glu ru len pa la// kunaṃ dgaṃ' khong nas 'dzuṃm du dmul ba'i zeṃr phreng 'bum// 'dzaṃg paṃ'i zlaṃ gzhoṃn lang tsho 'di ni nga yis ngom// sgrub phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu/ chod gtong ba phun tshogs khyim gyi phyir ma yin// mtshar sdug lta na ngoms med sgeg mo'i bzhin ras min// ngal brgyas sprul pa'i gzugs snang bu tsha'i ltad mo min// de phyir tshul 'di snyan dngags byed la bdag dga' skyes// mang ba'i dpe/ rin chen 'byung gnas zegs ma'i grangs du kun khyab mtha'// kun gzod dkyil 'khor phra rab rdul gyi grangs snyed bzhin// dpal stug snang brnyan tshad mar bsgrubs pa'i las bzang gi /grangs mtha' dpyod la mes po'i blo yang lan brgyar ngal// rmad byung gi dpe/ zla zer 'thungs myos sa la dga' ba'i me tog dkar// srid pas sprul pa'i kha na ma tho 'phrog pa'i mthu// yongs su rdzogs na bdag cag tshul 'dir 'bad pas mtshon// rnam dkar dge tshogs phung po'i rjes su byed pa de// srid

shis par brjod pa/ pa'i dpal nas byang chub bar gyi bde ba'i rgyur// sems can thams cad smin par byed pa'i blo gros ni// zab yangs bskyed pa rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi bcud// e waṃ yi ges mtshan pa'i bstan pa rgyas phyir bsngo// bsngags rig byed pa'i lo rgyus dang sbyar ba'i mtha' dag gzugs can/ brjod snyan dngags chu klung bye snyed btung bas kyang*// nam yang ngoms med chos rgyal sngon gyi drang srong gis// rnam dkar phrin las yan lag brgyad ldan skyugs pa'i rgyun// chab 'bangs kyis mtshon 'jig rten bde ba'i nyer 'tshor shog / bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ yangs pa'i 'jig rten pad+ma bzhad pa'i chu gter klong*// phun tshogs phan bde'i rlabs phreng chal chil g.yo ba'i nang*// ris bral sems can ngang pa dga' ba'i 'phur lding bsgyur// mdza' gcugs mchid kyi mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol gyur cig /mthar dag gzugs can/ āt+ma byang chub bar du dal 'byor skye ba'i shing*// tshulaṃ khriṃms la gnas gzhung lugs bye ba'i lo 'dab rdzogs// bcu phrag rig pa'i 'dod dgu'i gtong ba rmad byung gis// 'gro ba'i bsam rdzogs dpag bsam riṃn cheṃn mchog gyur cig / mtha' dag gzugs can gyi shis par brjod pa/ gang zhig thog ma'i thugs bskyed g.yar dam zho 'thungs bu yi rus skyes rdo rjes gzhig tu med pa'i rwa bar gnas// bar skabs bsdu dngos pha rol phyin lam bskal pa'i phreng bar rmad byung spyod spyad snying stobs go ca rab tu mkhregs// srid mthar byang chub rkang 'thung rtsa bar mi phyed rdo rje skyil krung gcig srid yid srubs sder bcas g.yul ngo bcil// bsnyengs bral gdong lnga'i nga ro rab bsgrags chos kyi sgo mang phye ba'i dge legs srid pa 'di na gsal gyur cig /ces chos kyi sde'i gtsug lag khang gzhan 'phrul mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba bskrun pa las 'phros pa'i gleng ba kun dga'i 'dzum zer 'dzag pa'i zla gzhon zhes bya ba 'di ni/

mtshungs pa med pa'i stobs kyi 'khor los phyogs bral yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dbang sgyur ba'i sde dge sa skyong bla ma lcam dral gyi bzhed pa bzhin du/ gang de'i bka' lung gi phrin las rjes su sgrub pa'i mdun na 'don dam pa gtsug lag zung gi mkhyen dpyod rnam par yangs pa dge slong bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i bkas bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyis lung bstan pa'i rgyal tshab kyi skyes bu chen po rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa'i rjes su zhugs shing rjes su slob pa'i 'dun pa ma bskyud tsam gyi ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i tshul gyis btags ming du ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sder bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i nang gses na tshod ldan zhes bya ba gsar tshes kyi gnam lo/ sgron ma'i bskal pa bzang po'i rnam 'dren bzhi pas shrī dhā n+ya ka ṭa ka'am dpal 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten chen por gsang bdag sa dbang gi sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa chos rgyal zla bzang la sogs pa'i las can gyi 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus su rgyud kyi rgyal po kā la tsakra'i bdud rtsi'i sgo 'phar chen po phye ba'i dus kyi zla ba/ dus 'khor ba'i dpyid tha chungs rags pa nag pas nya ba/ zhib par sa ri/ yar ngo sngon 'gro lug gi khyim du rta bdun rgyal pos dgyes dgur rtsen pa/ mdo sde gser 'od dam pa dang dus 'khor lugs kyi lo mgor 'dzin cing*/ gso ba rig pa dang hor lugs mthun pa'i zla ba gsum pa/ gtsug lag spor thang pa'i dbyar 'bring po lcags rta/ phyogs gnyis las dkar po'i phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa/ gza' rgyu skar khams sbyor stobs dang ldan pa'i nyin/ 'bri chu gser ldan ma'i rgyun chen po rlung phyogs nas bsreg bya za ba'i phyogs su nor rgyas kyi bu'i 'gros su dal gyis 'bab pa'i 'gram ngogs chos kyi sde zhes bya ba'i bsam 'grub pho brang gi dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par legs par grub par sug bris su bgyis pa dge legs rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/
